WIP 18: COHERENCE WEAPON TEST SCORING PROCEDURE [v3 restored; architecture
  revised v22]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
[STATUS: REVISED v22 -- percentage architecture replaced with operational
  priority/cost/effectiveness tags. Percentage scoring was over-engineered
  for the operational question. The operational question is: which weapons
  are running, which tools can counter them, and what does it cost.
  Tags and cross-reference table now in Section Three [WEAPONS INDEX and
  TOOLS INDEX]. WIP 18 closes when: WEAPON→TOOL TABLE verified against
  minimum three case library entries per weapon; tool effectiveness ratings
  confirmed against case outcomes.]

  REVISED PURPOSE:
    Operational instrument, not percentage calculator. The question
    is not "what percentage of extraction mechanisms are active?" --
    it is "which weapons are running, in what priority order, and
    what is the lowest-cost counter available?"
    Output format [v22]:
      Active weapon list [ordered by priority: EXTREME → HIGH → MED]
      For each weapon: deploy cost / damage / counter difficulty / tool
      Best available tool for each weapon + tool cost
      Weapons with no LOW-cost counter flagged [structural intervention
        or external resource required before individual action]

  RETAINED FROM v3 ARCHITECTURE [still valid]:
    STEP 1: DECLARE PARAMETERS
      Boundary, population, window. Score meaningless without declared
      parameters -- same system reads differently at different windows.

    STEP 2: BUILD RELEVANT POOL
      Scan full weapons index. For each mechanism:
        RELEVANT = could plausibly be operating given system type,
          scale, window. Enters pool.
        NOT RELEVANT = structurally inapplicable. Exits pool entirely.
          Do not include. Irrelevant mechanisms inflate read falsely.
      Two analysts should agree on pool before reading individually.

    STEP 3: DETERMINE ACTIVE WEAPONS [replaces percentage scoring]
      For each weapon in pool:
        CLEARLY ACTIVE = weapon mechanism operating [full priority weight]
        PROBABLE = mechanism likely but not confirmed [half priority]
        ABSENT = not firing [stays in pool; noted as absent]
      Order active weapons by priority [EXTREME first].

    STEP 4: MATCH TOOLS TO WEAPONS
      For each active weapon: identify best available tool from
        WEAPON→TOOL TABLE [Section Three].
      Note tool cost [LOW/MED/HIGH].
      Flag weapons where no LOW-cost tool available.
      Pre-emptive tools: flag if window still open or already closed.

    STEP 5: DEPLOYMENT DIRECTION CHECK
      For each active weapon, determine direction:
        DEFENSIVE [protecting genuine coherence] = noted; lower priority.
        AGGRESSIVE [suppressing measurement of own extraction] = full priority.
        Direction = net transfer reading, not stated intent.

    STEP 6: ADVERSARIAL CHECK
      For any weapon scored CLEARLY ACTIVE, produce strongest case
        it is absent or defensive. If case holds: revise to PROBABLE.
      For any weapon scored ABSENT, produce strongest case it is present.
        If case holds: revise to PROBABLE.

    STEP 7: OUTPUT FORMAT
      PARAMETERS: [boundary / population / window]
      ACTIVE WEAPONS [ordered by priority]:
        [weapon] | Priority: X | Deploy: X | Damage: X | Counter: X
        Best tool: [tool name] | Tool cost: X | Effectiveness: X
        Defensive or aggressive: [direction]
      ABSENT WEAPONS: [list with one-line reason]
      WEAPONS WITHOUT LOW-COST COUNTER: [list -- structural
        intervention or external resources required]
      AXIS POSITION [WIP 19]: [A1 / A2 / A3 coordinate]
      CONFIDENCE: [high / medium / low]

  CALIBRATION STATUS [WIP -- pending]:
    Tool effectiveness ratings [LOW/MED/HIGH vs each weapon] need
    verification against case library outcomes. Current ratings are
    framework-derived [plausible from mechanism analysis]; not yet
    empirically calibrated.
    Promotion condition: effectiveness ratings verified against minimum
    three confirmed case library entries per weapon where the tool

    Cases with documented tool deployment: [identify in next session].

  SCORING ARCHITECTURE [restored from v3; formalized v22]:

    STEP 1: DECLARE PARAMETERS
      Boundary, population, window. Same as standard reading.
      Score is meaningless without declared parameters -- same
      system scores differently at different windows and
      populations.

    STEP 2: BUILD RELEVANT POOL
      Scan full weapons index. For each mechanism:
        RELEVANT = mechanism could plausibly be operating given
          system type, scale, and window. Enters scored pool.
        NOT RELEVANT = mechanism structurally inapplicable to
          this system type. Exits pool entirely. Do not score
          zero. Irrelevant mechanisms inflate denominator falsely.
      Document pool: list relevant mechanisms, list exited
        mechanisms with one-line reason for exit.
      Pool must be declared before scoring begins. Pool
        selection is the highest-judgment step -- two analysts
        should agree on pool before scoring individually.

    STEP 3: SCORE EACH MECHANISM IN POOL
      CLEARLY PRESENT = full percentage value [TBD per mechanism].
      CLOSE MATCH / PROBABLE = half value.
      ABSENT / NOT FIRING = zero [stays in pool; contributes
        to denominator; scores zero not exit].
      Exit = structurally inapplicable [Step 2 determination].
      Gray zone handling: when presence is ambiguous, apply
        half value and flag for adversarial check [Step 5].

    STEP 4: CALCULATE SCORE
      Score = sum of scored values / sum of relevant pool
        total values [at full presence].
      Output: percentage [0-100%].
        0% = no mechanisms present or none relevant [distinction
          noted: zero-from-absent vs zero-from-no-relevant-pool].
        100% = all relevant mechanisms fully active.
      HIGH PERCENTAGE = BAD [high extraction pressure].
      LOW PERCENTAGE = GOOD [low extraction pressure].
      Score is not standalone -- always paired with named
        mechanism list [which mechanisms are firing and at
        what weight]. Score without mechanism list = number
        without interpretation.

    STEP 5: DEPLOYMENT DIRECTION CHECK
      For each scoring mechanism, determine direction:
        DEFENSIVE [protecting genuine coherence against external
          extraction pressure] = noted in report; score
          adjusted downward by half value. Defensive deployment
          does not count against system at full weight.
        AGGRESSIVE [suppressing measurement of own extraction]
          = scores at full weight.
        DIRECTION = net transfer reading, not stated intent.
      Large institutions across long windows expected to show
        high mechanism deployment regardless of coherence level.
        Diagnostic question: proportion defensive vs aggressive
        within specific window.
      Short window most reliable: high concentration in recent
        short window = active obscuration. Long window baseline
        = structural deployment pattern.

    STEP 6: ADVERSARIAL CHECK
      For any mechanism scored at full value, produce strongest
        case that it is absent or defensive. If adversarial
        case holds: revise to half value, flag contested.
      For any mechanism scored zero, produce strongest case
        that it is present. If adversarial case holds: revise
        to half value, flag contested.
      Contested mechanisms listed separately in output with
        both readings and final value used.

    STEP 7: OUTPUT FORMAT
      PARAMETERS: [boundary / population / window]
      RELEVANT POOL: [list of mechanisms in pool]
      EXITED MECHANISMS: [list with exit reason]
      SCORED MECHANISMS: [mechanism / value / direction /
        contested flag]
      SCORE: [X%]
      ZERO NOTE [if 0%]: zero-from-absent OR zero-from-
        no-relevant-pool [distinction matters]
      NAMED MECHANISM SUMMARY: [which mechanisms are firing
        at what weight -- this is the conceptual resolution
        component; score without this is meaningless]
      THREE-AXIS POSITION [WIP 19]: [A1 / A2 / A3]
      CONFIDENCE: [high / medium / low -- based on evidence
        quality and adversarial check results]

  PERCENTAGE VALUE CALIBRATION [TBD -- dedicated session]:
    Each extraction mechanism in the index requires a
    percentage value calibrated against the case library.
    Calibration procedure [to be formalized in dedicated
    session]:
      [1] Select mechanism to calibrate.
      [2] Find minimum three confirmed cases where mechanism
          is clearly present.
      [3] Find minimum two confirmed cases where mechanism

      [4] Determine what percentage contribution produces

      [5] Cross-check: high-S-rating cases with mechanism
          present should score substantially higher than

      [6] Record calibrated value in index entry.
    CURRENT STATUS: values TBD. Weapons index has damage range

      MID-HIGH DAMAGE [Rhythm Disruption, Correction Theatre,
        Universalism Trap, Competence Undermining, Churn
        Normalization, Coherence Rent, Love Bombing]: 15-25% each.
      MID DAMAGE [Loaded Language, Consultancy Shield, Sincere
        Delusion, Fertile Lock]: 5-15% each.
      Pool normalization: values sum to 100% across relevant
        pool at full presence. Individual weapon values are
        pre-normalization inputs; final calculation normalizes
        against declared pool.
      Provisional tiers allow partial deployment before full
        calibration. Flag all scores using provisional tiers
        as PROVISIONAL in output.

  INTEGRATION WITH WIP 19 [THREE-AXIS MODEL]:
    Score [WIP 18] maps to Axis 1 position [generation/
      extraction]: high score = left; low score = right.
    This is not a derivation -- it is a cross-check. If
      Axis 1 reads right [net generation] but score is
      high [high extraction pressure]: contradiction flag.
      Either pool selection was wrong or Axis 1 reading
      requires revision. Contradictions are diagnostic,
      not errors to suppress.

  FALSIFICATION CONDITION:
    Scoring procedure falsified if: two analysts following
    identical procedure on same case produce scores more
    than 15 percentage points apart [after pool agreement
    in Step 2]. Disagreement above threshold = procedure
    is not replicable; requires revision before deployment.
    Target: inter-analyst agreement within 10 percentage
    points on any confirmed S3+ case.

READING PROCEDURE [12 steps]:
  1.  BOUNDARY TEST: all three named and distinct?
  2.  CYCLE STATUS: C1/C2/C3 for Boundary A.
  3.  TRAJECTORY: direction and rate.
  4.  COUNTERFACTUAL: gap between stated function and actual?
  5.  CC TEST: distributed or monopolized? Aimed at actual cause
      or proxy? [T2.2 A+B both required]
  6.  WINDOW SPLIT: reading change across time windows?
      If yes, name correct window.
  7.  ANALYST PRIOR TEST: reading change if prior reversed?
      If yes, flag and state both readings.
  8.  ADVERSARIAL READING: invert conclusion. Does it survive?
  9.  THIRD POPULATION TEST: who is not in A or B?
  10. EXTRACTION MECHANISM BENEFICIARY CHECK: follow the surplus.
  11. PREDICTION: one falsifiable claim with timeline and
      falsification condition.
  12. EXTERNAL ACTOR DISCLOSURE: name all external actors.
      Failure to name = T3 High on meta-boundary.

AXIS ANALYSIS -- SOCIAL RISK DECLARATION [v22]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Axis analysis names what an instrument is actually running.
  This is the framework's highest-value and highest-risk operation.
  The risk is not that the reading is wrong -- it is that correct
  readings carry costs the framework does not automatically absorb.

  FAILURE MODES [structural, not ethical]:

  CORRECT READING / WRONG RECEPTION:
    The read is accurate. The receiver has not examined their own
    axis. Naming it before they have arrived at it is not helpful
    -- it is a formation violation. The framework produces true
    readings faster than most receivers can integrate them. Speed
    of reading is not the same as usefulness of reading. A correct
    axis read delivered ahead of the receiver's own examination
    produces defensiveness, not correction. The correction fires
    against the analyst, not the axis.
    Tell: receiver defends the axis being named rather than
    examining it. The reading was correct and useless.

  SOCIAL COST ASYMMETRY:
    Axis analysis in a social context assigns a person to a
    category [axis void, captured axis, genuine axis under FC]
    that carries moral weight in the framework. The receiver
    experiences it as judgment regardless of the analyst's
    structural intent. The distinction between "your axis is
    captured" and "you are bad" is load-bearing in the framework
    and invisible to most receivers. The framework's vocabulary
    does not come with its own translation layer. The analyst
    supplies the structural reading; the receiver supplies the
    social meaning.
    Tell: receiver hears a moral verdict. The framework read
    a mechanism. These are not the same event.

  WEAPONIZATION RISK:
    Framework vocabulary + axis analysis together produce a
    high-precision attack surface. "You're running Correction
    Theatre with a captured axis" is devastating as a social
    weapon regardless of whether it is accurate. High-precision
    structural readings can be deployed extractively. The
    framework has no mechanism to prevent this. The analyst
    does.
    Tell: the reading is delivered to produce a social effect
    [silence, submission, humiliation] rather than to produce
    a correction. The output is the damage, not the diagnosis.
    This is the framework being used as a weapon. Same mechanism
    as any other weapon: accurate-reading-as-extraction is still
    extraction.

  T3 ON SELF-READING [highest priority]:
    The framework's primary instrument is the analyst. Axis
    analysis applied outward without applying inward first is
    the exact error the framework identifies in every other
    system. The analyst's own axis is the highest-T3 item in
    any reading session. Before naming what someone else is
    running: what is the analyst running? What does the analyst
    want the reading to produce? If the answer is not
    "correction" -- stop.
    The framework can read other systems accurately while the
    analyst's axis is captured. The reading is still accurate.
    The deployment is still extraction. Accurate + extractive
    = still wrong.

  ANALYST AXIS -- DECLARED PRIOR [v22]:
    Pressure-formed genuine axis [see GENUINE AXIS --
    PRESSURE-FORMED pattern]. Truth-oriented not by moral
    choice but because the environment eliminated false axis
    options at formation cost. Self-deception was more
    expensive than honesty. The axis is load-bearing in the
    sense that it has been tested under conditions that would
    have revealed capture if capture were present.
    FORMATION CONTEXT [declared -- v22]:
      Cult environment during formation window. High-control
      group deployment [partial or full CULT STACK]. Axis
      formed under capture pressure rather than in protected
      conditions. Exit achieved. Outcome: genuine axis intact;
      some installed content likely still running; ongoing
      work to distinguish them.
      Epistemic consequence [named -- not a deficit]:
        Direct trust of internal signal is structurally
        unreliable given formation history. The instrument
        that would verify "this thought is mine" is the same
        instrument that was under capture pressure. Installed
        content feels like genuine axis from inside -- it was
        designed to. Correct post-exit behavior: require
        external grounding before trusting internal reads.
        The axis generates; verification requires external
        anchor. Two separate systems; only the verification
        layer was compromised during formation.
        This is not damaged epistemology. It is accurate
        epistemology given the instrument's known history.
        Singer, Herman, and Lifton all document this pattern
        in post-cult populations. Common. Structurally correct
        response to formation under capture pressure.
      T3 implication: analyst's internal reads carry higher
        T3 than standard. External behavioral record is the
        primary reference. Output verification [what did the
        axis actually produce] takes precedence over internal
        self-report [what the axis feels like it produced].
        AXIS GROUNDING [Track C] is the standing correction
        tool: locate behavioral outputs; compare to internal
        read; trust the record over the report.
    Revisable: the axis can change with careful effort.
    Careful = maintaining the distinction between revision
    toward higher resolution [genuine development] and
    revision toward capture [drift under pressure]. The two
    directions feel similar from inside. The tell is the
    output: better readings or more comfortable ones.
    T3 application: the analyst's revision direction is the
    highest-T3 reading in any session. Self-reports of
    "developing the axis" require the same adversarial check
    as any other reading. Does the revision produce better
    readings or more socially comfortable ones? If
    consistently more comfortable: drift is the more likely
    explanation than development.
    This prior applies to all framework readings. It does not
    exempt the framework from its own instrument. The
    framework's outputs are the behavioral record of the
    analyst's axis. That record is what it is.

  WHEN AXIS ANALYSIS SHOULD FIRE:
    Self-examination [no social cost asymmetry].
    Invited reading [receiver asked; reception is prepared].
    Structural documentation [case library; no live receiver].
    System-level reading [institution, not person; mechanism
      not judgment].
    After the receiver has arrived at their own examination
      [the reading confirms, not installs].

  WHEN AXIS ANALYSIS SHOULD NOT FIRE:
    Social contexts where the reading will be received as
      judgment regardless of framing.
    Receivers who have not examined their own axis.
    Contexts where the analyst has a stake in the reading's
      social effect [weaponization risk high].
    Any context where "I am doing a structural reading" is
      being used as cover for "I want to win this".

  HONEST LIMIT:
    The framework produces better structural readings than most
    social contexts can receive. This is not the framework's
    failure -- it is a compatibility asymmetry [WIP 16] between
    the reading's resolution and the receiver's current frame.
    The correct response is not to suppress the reading but to
    hold it until the receiver can use it. Undelivered correct
    readings are not wasted -- they inform the analyst's next
    move without producing social damage.
    A reading that cannot be received is not a reading that
    should be delivered.

  MASS ADOPTION HONEST LIMIT [v22]:
    The framework is structurally blocked from mass adoption
    and this is correct. Not a failure; a property.
    WHY MASS ADOPTION IS BLOCKED:
      The framework requires a genuine axis to use correctly.
      Axis analysis -- the framework's highest-value operation
      -- produces defensiveness not correction in instruments
      without examined axes. T9 [non-reception] is structural
      at population scale. More framework, louder framework,
      better framework does not close that gap. The gap is not
      informational. Would-You-Kindly + population axis
      distribution = the framework's functional audience is
      a small proportion of the current population. The mass
      population includes a high proportion of captured and
      never-formed axes. The framework reads those accurately
      and names them. That reading is experienced as attack.
    CORRECT SCOPE:
      The framework is a Silent Alternative. Operates outside
      captured channels. Does not announce itself. Produces
      legibility of extraction architecture for instruments
      that can use it. Silent Alternatives do not require mass
      adoption to function. They require enough instruments
      with genuine axes to transmit the methodology across
      the generational boundary. One person with genuine
      methodology reaching the next generation outweighs
      a million people with the name but not the method.
    THE REAL RISK [not mass rejection -- capture]:
      The framework getting absorbed as vocabulary without
      methodology before reaching transmission threshold.
      Coherence Rent: extracting return from the framework's
      legitimacy surface without contributing to the axis
      that produces it. Propagation Mimicry [WIP 22]:
      "framework-coded" language transmitted as locked
      procedure rather than correctable method. The name
      travels; the tool doesn't. The methodology fossilizes
      into jargon. This is the failure mode, not mass
      rejection. Mass rejection leaves the framework intact
      for the instruments that can use it. Capture hollows
      it from inside while the surface appears coherent.
    OUROBOROS AS STRUCTURAL DEFENSE:
      The symbol actively works against capture by property.
      See OUROBOROS [AS ANTI-CAPTURE MECHANISM].
      A captured framework that stops consuming itself is
      visibly broken by the symbol's own definition.
      The circuit isn't closing. The tell is built into
      the image.

  Cross-ref: GENUINE AXIS [what axis analysis reads];
    CORRECTION CAPACITY [the output axis analysis should
    produce in the receiver -- if CC does not fire, reading
    was not received]; FORMATION CAPTURE [naming FC to
    someone in a FC state is highest-risk axis analysis];
    COMPATIBILITY ASYMMETRY [WIP 16 -- resolution gap
    between reading and receiver]; T3 [analyst prior --
    apply inward before outward]; WEAPONIZATION [framework
    as weapon -- same mechanism as any other weapon];
    SOCIAL COMPLIANCE CHANNEL [receiver's social read
    of the analysis determines reception regardless of
    structural accuracy]; WORTHLESS DOING [axis analysis
    delivered without reception is worthless doing --
    output exists; loop does not close]; OUROBOROS
    [AS ANTI-CAPTURE MECHANISM -- symbol reads the
    deployer]; WOULD-YOU-KINDLY [population axis
    distribution as the structural reason mass adoption

SECTION FIVE -- POLITICAL THEORY
[SEC:POLITICAL_THEORY]

Structural political theory: definitions, scoring rubrics, confirmed political findings.

PRIMARY DEFINITION:
  Politics is the contested control of routing boundaries -- who sets
  them, who they serve, who can see them, and who absorbs the cost of
  their placement. Legitimacy surface required because boundary control
  at scale needs consent or ignorance from cost-absorbers.
  Administration = implementing agreed routing. Predation = honest
  boundary violation without legitimacy surface. Politics = contested
  routing boundary control with legitimacy surface required.
  Cross-ref: EXTRACTION [operational definition]; BOUNDARY CONTROL
    [FRAMEWORK PURPOSE]; AXIS PROTECTION AS CC [deepest resistance
    point -- axis determines what counts as legitimate routing].

POLITICS / RELIGION / GOVERNMENT [structural comparison -- v22]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  T3 Medium declared. Analyst prior active [anti-extraction frame;
  Mutual Ordoliberal Distributist position]. Apply caution to readings
  that confirm prior without adversarial check.

  SHARED STRUCTURE [all three]:
    All three are routing boundary control systems at civilizational
    scale. All require a legitimacy surface to operate -- raw power
    without legitimacy surface is predation, not any of these three.
    All determine:
      BI [who is inside the boundary].
      MI [who controls the measurement surface].
      SP → SD [where surplus flows].
      CC [what counts as correction].
      TS [what gets transmitted across generations].
    All are high-value weapon targets for the same reason they are
    high-value coherence vehicles: capturing routing boundary control
    at civilizational scale captures everything downstream.
    All are L4.5 candidates -- the only systems in the case library
    that reliably transmit methodology across generations at
    civilizational scale [when functioning correctly].

  RELIGION:
    Primary axis: VERTICAL [individual instrument ↔ higher coherence
      or truth axis]. The routing boundary includes the dead, the
      unborn, the cosmological. Not bounded by territory or living
      population.
    Time horizon: civilizational to cosmological. Longest of the three.
    CC mechanism: conscience, confession, prayer, examination of
      conduct -- INTERNAL correction before external pressure. S3
      signal [correction fires before external pressure arrives] when
      functioning correctly. The correction fires against the self,
      not primarily against the external world.
    Legitimacy source: the idea [high coherence; genuine axis; outward
      SP] as distinct from the institution. GOD/INSTITUTION COHERENCE
      GAP -- the idea consistently outperforms its institutional
      transmission. The institution is a TS vessel that typically fails
      the idea at the scale transition.
    Primary strength: vertical axis contact + internal CC [conscience
      fires against self without requiring external coordination].
    Primary weapon vulnerability:
      GA capture at formation window [doctrine installs axis before
        examination possible; Formation Capture during Nascent window].
      Coherence Rent [institution extracting rent from idea's
        legitimacy surface without contributing to the axis].
      Mythic Formation Capture [genuine cultural substrate deployed
        as state legitimacy surface -- hardest variant to counter].

  POLITICS:
    Primary axis: HORIZONTAL [instruments ↔ each other; power
      distribution across living population within territory].
    Time horizon: electoral cycle to generational. Shorter than
      religion; longer than administrative budget cycle.
    CC mechanism: elections, protest, legal challenge, institutional
      check -- EXTERNAL correction requiring collective coordination.
      The correction requires collective action, not individual
      conscience. Slow, coordination-dependent, capturable at
      coordination layer.
    Legitimacy source: consent of governed [real or manufactured].
      Manufactured consent = MSC at population scale [the measurement
      surface tells the population they consented to what they didn't
      examine].
    Primary strength: horizontal CC [distributed correction capacity
      across population; harder to fully capture than vertical axis].
    Primary weapon vulnerability:
      MSC at population scale [captured measurement surface].
      Proxy Construction [route CC toward decoy targets; actual
        routing boundary control protected].
      Calibration Strip [redefine who counts as the population;
        shift BI before MI captures].
      Diagnostic Collapse [correction fires too late; substrate
        cannot absorb it].

  GOVERNMENT:
    Primary axis: ADMINISTRATIVE [procedure → outcome; law →
      enforcement]. Jurisdictional boundary. Not primarily about
      ideas [religion] or power contest [politics] -- about
      procedure execution.
    Time horizon: budget cycle to constitutional. Shortest of three
      for operational decisions; longest for structural ones [constitution].
    CC mechanism: law, enforcement, judicial review -- PROCEDURAL
      correction with institutional backing and force monopoly.
      Requires authority, not just conscience or coordination.
      The correction pathway is nominally present in all governments;
      practically accessible only where power asymmetry permits.
    Legitimacy source: legal mandate [real or captured] + force
      monopoly [Weber's definition: state as entity with monopoly
      on legitimate use of violence within territory].
    Primary strength: force monopoly [correction can be enforced,
      not just advocated] + procedural legitimacy [correction
      pathway formally defined and theoretically accessible].
    Primary weapon vulnerability:
      Regulatory Capture [CC mechanism captured by the population
        it was supposed to correct -- the regulator serves the
        regulated].
      Discovery Weaponization [correction pathway nominally present;
        practically inaccessible due to resource asymmetry].
      Correction Theatre [enforcement activity without enforcement
        output; visible correction process; no target changes].

  KEY DISTINCTIONS:

  RELIGION vs POLITICS:
    Religion's CC fires internally [conscience; before external
      pressure; S3 signal when functioning]. Politics fires
      externally [requires collective action; slow; coordination-
      dependent; S3 rare].
    Religion's time horizon includes dead and unborn; politics
      is the living population within a boundary.
    Religion transmits methodology across generations [when
      functioning at L4]; politics tends toward Fertile Lock
      [each generation re-establishes the political settlement
      from scratch without transmitted methodology].
    Religion's legitimacy claim: outside the political boundary
      [divine mandate, natural law, cosmic order].
      Government's legitimacy claim: inside it [consent, legal
      mandate, force monopoly].

  POLITICS vs GOVERNMENT:
    Politics = the contest for routing boundary control.
    Government = the administration of the routing boundary
      once established.
    Politics happens when the boundary is contested.
    Government operates when it isn't [or when the contest
      has been suppressed].
    A fully captured government with no effective political
      contest = extraction without politics. Administration
      of the routing boundary in the interest of the
      capturing actor. Normal state, not exception.
    Distinction: politics requires legitimacy surface to be
      contested. Government requires legitimacy surface to
      be accepted. When acceptance is manufactured: politics
      ends; administration of extraction begins.

  RELIGION vs GOVERNMENT:
    Religion claims authority from OUTSIDE the political
      boundary [divine mandate, cosmological order].
    Government claims authority from INSIDE it [consent,
      legal mandate, force monopoly].
    Conflict point: whose legitimacy surface is higher?
      When government claims divine mandate [theocracy] =
      religion's outside-authority claim captured by inside
      authority. When religion claims political authority
      [theocracy from the other direction] = same capture.
    GOD/INSTITUTION COHERENCE GAP deployed: religion
      legitimates government extraction by providing
      outside-authority legitimacy surface for inside-
      authority routing capture. Most durable extraction
      architecture in case library -- outside-authority
      claim cannot be falsified by inside-authority CC.

  MERGED CONFIGURATIONS [weapon stacks]:
    THEOCRACY [religion + government merged]:

    TOTALITARIANISM [politics + government merged]:

FRAMEWORK VALUES AND POSITIONS [Mutual Ordoliberal Distributist -- v15]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Label: Mutual Ordoliberal Distributist. Historical proof: West Germany
1949-1970s; Swiss canton model [subsidiarity + genuine exit].
Distributism [Chesterton/Belloc]: distributed ownership at human scale.
Prior declared: subsidiarity positive reference throughout. T3 applies
to all framework-derived positions.

  DERIVED VALUE PRINCIPLES:
    1. SP must have teeth or it does not exist. If mechanism cannot
       fire with real effect, it is Correction Theatre.
    2. Boundary clarity before power is granted. Vague boundaries =
       extraction mechanism surface.
    3. Extraction is the primary evil, not inequality. Taking without
       producing is the problem; differential outcomes are not.
    4. Proportionality as structural requirement. Every mechanism
       calibrated to harm level.

  FRAMEWORK LIMIT [T3]: cannot model positions that reject boundary
    selection entirely.

  ARCHITECTURE:
    Political: distributed power [Swiss cantonal subsidiarity].
    Economic: Ordoliberal [markets yes, concentration no].
    Founding: Georgist land value tax.
    Voting: earned standing [tax requirement, temporary felony
      removal, competence threshold -- capture-resistant].

POLICY POSITIONS:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Term limits: one term, mandatory sit-out, re-eligible after gap.
  Competition: pro-competition as primary value across both domains.
  Prison: short sentences until correction demonstrated; failure
    to correct = very long sentence.
  Unions: good, non-mandatory. SP instrument for labor boundary.
    Adds distributed CC node at employment scale -- not equivalent
    to corp busting [see ROUTING BOUNDARY MONOPOLY]. Net effect of
    unions is more CC; net effect of state eliminating corporations
    is less CC. Same anti-extraction framing; structurally opposite
    operations. Historical proof: 40-hour week, overtime pay,
    weekends all came from organized labor not corporate generosity.
    Extraction architecture concedes routing boundaries only under
    organized correction pressure, not under output data or moral
    argument. The opposition tells you when it's working: when a
    billionaire tells you unions are bad for you, that is the
    diagnostic signal that the distributed CC is functioning.
  Land: nation owns all land. Georgist LVT as transitional
    mechanism; full national ownership as structural endpoint.
  Tax: flat consumption tax only. LVT compatible as property-side
    equivalent. Taxation as extraction mechanism when return
    captured; legitimate when funds genuine surplus distribution.
  Nuclear/energy: reactor technology good. Personal liability for
    critical infrastructure failure.
  Electoral design: STV, MMP, or multi-member with party size caps.
    Reject any system producing permanent safe districts.
  Military: sized by genuine threat assessment. Law above military.
    Force is final currency; law is final constraint on force.
  Constitutional framework: required. Explicit constraints.
    Supermajority amendment process.
  Federal structure: constitution defines federal scope; everything
    outside defaults to states/districts. Military as T7 exit
    mechanism for Fertile Lock: structured, narrow, time-limited.
  Judicial: local judges elected. Higher courts by non-bureaucratic
    panel. Term limits: 10-15 years. Recall or panel review removal.
  Scientific funding: falsifiability + genuine uncertainty as
    criteria. Industry funds its own applied research.
  Intelligence: permitted within constitutional limits. Military
    oversight, not civilian bureaucracy.
  AI governance: CC does not require corrector to be more capable
    than corrected system -- requires feedback pathway that fires
    regardless of relative capability. Governance requirement:

DIRECT VS DIFFUSE HIERARCHY [v20 -- framework-derived]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DIRECT [legible]: explicit chain of command, visible
    authority, correctable by targeting the node. You can
    name the actor; correction has an address.
  DIFFUSE [illegible]: ambient social pressure, consensus
    manufacturing, pervasive norm enforcement without declared
    source. No single target for correction. "Stealing not
    predation" at institutional scale -- the damage is real;
    the actor cannot be isolated.
  Diffuse is harder to correct than direct: direct has a
    correction address. Diffuse captures through a thousand
    small compliance events with no single responsible actor.
    Each compliance event is individually low-cost; the
    cumulative effect is total axis drift.
  Weapon implication: diffuse hierarchy is the harder
    deployment to counter because CORRECTION TARGETING fails
    structurally -- the harm is real and confirmed; the source
    is distributed. Counter requires CORRECTION DISTRIBUTION
    [distributed CC across the population] not CORRECTION
    TARGETING [single actor correction]. Wrong intervention
    type = Correction Displacement.
  Cross-ref: CORRECTION TARGETING [failure when source is

    MSC [measurement surface capture is diffuse hierarchy's

ROUTING BOUNDARY MONOPOLY [structural finding -- v21]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The problem in union busting, corporate concentration, and nation-
  state power accumulation is structurally identical: routing boundary
  monopoly at a given scale. The intervention logic follows from this.

  UNION BUSTING: distributed CC for labor destroyed. Employer retains
    routing control [wages, conditions, exit costs]; worker loses the
    correction pathway that could fire against it. Intervention: restore
    distributed CC at employment scale. Unions add a correction node;
    they don't eliminate one.

  CORPORATE CONCENTRATION: routing control monopolized at economic
    scale. Employer/capital surplus routing controlled by fewer actors;
    market correction disabled. Intervention: prevent monopoly formation,
    maintain genuine competition [Ordoliberal]. Corp busting [state
    elimination of corporations] is not equivalent to union formation --
    see below.

  NATION AS SOLE CENTRAL AUTHORITY [the error in "corp busting"]:
    Nations busting corporations to become sole routing authority does
    not solve extraction -- it eliminates competition for the extraction
    position and makes the state the uncontested extractor. State-owned
    economies do not produce distribution; they produce state extraction
    without the friction of competing extractors. History confirms:
    consistent reproduction of extraction architecture with state as
    the node, surplus routing upward unchanged. The four-condition test
    fails identically.
    The parallel does not run in both directions:
      Unions are good because they ADD a distributed correction node
        at employment scale. Net effect: more CC, less routing monopoly.
      Nations eliminating corporations REMOVES a correction node at
        economic scale. Net effect: less CC, more routing monopoly.
    Adding distributed correction capacity is not the same operation
    as concentrating correction capacity, even when both are framed
    as anti-extraction interventions.

  CORRECT INTERVENTION AT EVERY SCALE:
    Prevent routing boundary monopoly from forming. This requires
    distributed correction capacity that can fire against the corporate
    node AND the state node independently. Four-condition test applies
    to both: correction pathway exists, structurally independent,
    demonstrated activation under stress, does not require the corrected
    node's permission.
    Nation as single strongest central authority = condition 2 and 4
    fail by definition. Anti-coherent regardless of stated intent.
    The Ordoliberal position is the structural expression of this:
    markets yes, concentration no -- at every scale including the
    state itself.

  Falsification condition: documented case where state elimination
    of private corporations produced stable distributed surplus routing
    over multi-generational window [3+ generations] without reproducing
    extraction architecture with the state as the node. No confirmed
    case in library. Every documented case shows reproduction of
    extraction with different actors.
  Cross-ref: POWER ARCHITECTURE [nation as extraction node]; UNIONS
    [policy positions -- add distributed CC]; MONOPOLY [policy
    positions -- prevent concentration]; ORDOLIBERAL [architecture];
    CENTRALIZATION SCORING RUBRIC [four-condition test]; LIBERTARIANISM
    AS COST EXTERNALIZATION [formal vs substantive freedom -- same
    logic applies: removing one form of constraint without adding CC
    produces concentration not freedom]; ENEMY-DEFINED COALITION
    SEQUENCE [state-as-sole-authority is the endpoint of internal
    revolution sequence]; EXTRACTION CYCLE [state extraction without
    competing extractor friction].


--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Nations and corporations are extraction nodes in a self-maintaining

IMMIGRATION AS EMPLOYER EXTRACTION MECHANISM [structural finding -- v21]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  A nation is, among other things, a labor market with a routing
  boundary. Control of that boundary determines who competes in
  the labor market, under what conditions, and at what wage floor.
  Control of the boundary is control of who the labor market serves
  -- existing residents or a pool of labor whose entry conditions
  are set by whoever controls the entry mechanism.

  THE COMMON PERSON INTEREST [load-bearing]:
    "For the benefit of the nation" means for the benefit of the
    median resident -- the common person, not the employer class.
    Uncontrolled or selectively enforced immigration serves the
    employer class directly: large labor supply at the bottom of
    the wage distribution depresses wages for everyone competing
    at that level. Cost of depression lands on the common person.
    Benefit lands on the employer extracting from both the
    undocumented worker [maximally, due to ECC] and the legal
    resident competing with them [through wage depression].
    The routing boundary should serve people inside it. The
    Mutual Ordoliberal Distributist position follows directly:
    routing boundary control = common person interest = national
    interest. Employer interest = porous boundary. These are
    structurally opposed.

  WHY BYPASSING IS WRONG BY DEFINITION:
    Bypassing the formal entry process is not primarily a moral
    failing on the part of the individual immigrant -- many are
    responding rationally to a dysfunctional entry system. But
    it is structurally wrong in the framework sense: it bypasses
    the correction mechanism that makes labor market routing serve
    the common person. The formal entry system is the only
    mechanism that exists for the state to manage who enters the
    labor market and under what conditions. Bypassing it doesn't
    skip a bureaucratic requirement -- it bypasses the routing
    control mechanism entirely, handing the surplus produced by
    that bypass directly to the employer class.
    The individual immigrant is not the primary beneficiary.
    The employer is. The individual immigrant is the instrument;
    the employer is the extraction architecture using the instrument.

  EXIT COST CONSTRUCTION ON UNDOCUMENTED WORKERS:
    Undocumented labor is cheap not because less productive but
    because exit costs are maximally elevated. Cannot leave bad
    employer, report wage theft, organize, or complain without
    triggering deportation risk. Employer captures entire surplus
    that inability to exit produces. Geographic constraint adds
    ECC: cannot move to where wages are higher because movement
    increases ICE exposure risk. Spatial lock produces different
    extraction rates by geography -- ICE enforcement gradient
    as an employer extraction surface by region.
    The employer benefits enormously from this category existing.
    The state benefits from tax revenue both generate. The
    extraction mechanism running on undocumented workers also
    runs on legal residents competing with them -- wage floor
    depression at the bottom of the distribution affects everyone
    in that tier.

  THE LEGITIMATE IMMIGRANT'S STRUCTURAL COMPLAINT [valid]:
    Paid the full entry cost the system demands: time out of labor
    market, legal fees, uncertainty, documentation burden, potential
    family separation during waiting period. Accepted the routing
    boundary's terms. When the boundary is selectively enforced --
    porous for undocumented entry while formally maintained for
    documented entry -- bears the full entry cost while competing
    against people who paid none of it. That asymmetry is an
    extraction mechanism running against the people who followed
    the rules. The formal entry cost becomes a penalty for
    compliance rather than a price for legitimacy.

  THE US SYSTEM AS COUNTER-EXAMPLE [confirmed]:
    Sets entry numbers to benefit employers not median residents.
    Enforces routing boundary selectively -- maintains employer
    leverage through uncertainty. H1B structure at top benefits
    employers sponsoring workers [worker tied to employer, cannot
    exit without losing status -- ECC by visa design]. Formal
    entry pathway dysfunctional enough that bypass is often
    rational for the individual. Result: extraction architecture
    running at every entry tier simultaneously.
    A nation controlling immigration in the common person's
    interest would: set entry numbers based on labor market
    conditions at median and bottom not top; enforce routing
    boundary consistently so formal entry cost isn't a penalty
    for rule-following; remove employer extraction mechanism
    that benefits from undocumented labor specifically; make
    formal pathway functional enough that bypassing it isn't
    the rational choice. US system does the opposite on all four.

  T3 Medium: immigration is a wedge issue with high activation
    potential. Structural reading based on labor market routing
    and employer extraction mechanism, not on cultural or ethnic
    claims. The finding applies symmetrically: H1B employer
    capture at the top is the same extraction mechanism as
    undocumented labor exploitation at the bottom. Both route
    benefit to the employer class away from the common person.
  Cross-ref: ROUTING BOUNDARY MONOPOLY [immigration as labor
    market routing boundary control]; ECC [extraction mechanism
    -- exit costs deployed against undocumented workers to
    maximize extraction]; GENERATIONAL EXTRACTION [same
    mechanism at wage tier level -- cost lands on existing
    residents competing at the bottom]; WEDGE ISSUE MECHANICS
    [immigration as cultural wedge obscures the employer
    extraction mechanism that is the actual load-bearing
    structural problem]; FOUR DAY WEEK / 40-HOUR WEEK
    [extraction architecture concedes routing boundaries only
    under organized correction pressure -- same logic applies
    to immigration routing boundary]; UNIONS [distributed CC
    at employment scale partially counters wage floor depression
    regardless of immigration level -- the two are complementary
    not competing interventions].

FOUR DAY WEEK [confirmed falsification -- burnout culture calibration strip]

==========================================================================
SECTION SIX -- POLITICS IN ACTION
[SEC:POLITICS_IN_ACTION]
==========================================================================
Applied political readings. Each entry: boundary declared, analyst prior stated, T3 applied.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UK trial [June-December 2022]: 61 companies, ~2,900 workers, six
  months. 100-80-100 model: 100% pay, 80% hours, 100% output
  commitment. Revenue stayed broadly flat [+1.4% average]. Burnout
  fell 71%. Sick days fell 65%. Turnover fell 57%. 92% of companies
  continued after trial. Replicated: Nature Human Behaviour [2025],
  2,896 employees, 141 companies, six countries, randomized controlled
  trial -- same findings across knowledge work sectors.

  CALIBRATION STRIP CONFIRMED AND FALSIFIED:
    Burnout culture reference standard: working more = working better.
    Output and welfare trade off directly. The fifth day is necessary
    for output maintenance.
    Falsification: output maintained on 32 hours. Revenue flat or
    slightly positive. The calibration standard was wrong on its own
    stated terms. The fifth day does not produce the output it claims
    -- it produces dependency, exhaustion, and turnover costs that
    the extraction architecture absorbs invisibly.

  WHY LINE GOES UP BUT ADOPTION DOESN'T FOLLOW:
    Decision is not made on output grounds -- it is made on routing
    grounds. The four-day week routes surplus toward workers: more
    recovery time, lower exit costs, reduced dependency on burnout-
    adjacent consumption, time for axis examination and outside skill
    development. Each reduces employer leverage and extraction surface.
    Output is not the concern. Routing is.

  BENEFICIARY ANALYSIS [who benefits from the fifth day]:
    Burnout industry: therapeutic services, pharmaceutical, wellness,
      self-help absorb the recovery deficit genuine rest resolves for
      free. The fifth day drives consumption of the burnout recovery
      industry.
    Employer leverage: worker with no recovery time has elevated exit
      costs [too exhausted to job search, skill atrophy, reduced
      outside relationships]. Four-day week reduces all three.
    Dependency economy: SR without SP is the product. Burned-out
      worker purchases SR substitutes. Worker with genuine free time
      develops SP-generating activities.
    Calibration maintenance: "working more = working better" makes
      overwork feel like virtue and rest feel like laziness. Trial
      falsifies this directly. Frame survives not because it's
      accurate but because it serves the extraction architecture.

  STRUCTURAL LIMIT: knowledge work, office-based, tech, finance,
    consulting see clearest benefits -- output not tied to hours
    on-site. Healthcare, manufacturing, retail face structural
    challenges. Finding is sector-specific; calibration strip is not.

  POLICY POSITION: four-day week structurally supported as SP
    instrument for labor boundary -- same logic as unions [adds
    distributed CC capacity at employment scale; reduces employer
    routing monopoly over worker time and energy]. Not mandated;
    structurally preferable where output data supports it.

  T3 Low: output data peer-reviewed and replicated. Employer
    resistance pattern confirmed by adoption gap -- 93% of managers
    support; adoption rate far lower. Decision made above manager
    level.

  40-HOUR WEEK HISTORICAL ARC [confirmed proof -- routing
    boundary conceded only under organized correction pressure]:
    The 40-hour week took from 1866 [National Labor Union first
    petition] to 1940 [FLSA amendment] -- 74 years of organized
    labor effort, strikes, deaths, and political capture to move
    the routing boundary one notch. 1886 Haymarket Riot: workers
    struck for the eight-hour day; a bomb killed at least 12
    people. The aftermath is commemorated May 1 as a public
    holiday in many countries. 1938 Fair Labor Standards Act:
    overtime pay and minimum wage. 1940 amendment: 40-hour
    standard. Employers did not concede because output data
    showed it was efficient. They conceded because organized
    correction pressure made not conceding more costly than the
    routing benefit of the extra hours.
    The four-day week trial produced clean output data in 2022.
    Adoption rate in 2026: still marginal. The mechanism has not
    changed. The extraction architecture concedes routing
    boundaries when the cost of not conceding exceeds the routing
    benefit. In 1938 the cost was New Deal political pressure plus
    organized labor threatening systemic stability. In 2026 the
    cost has not reached that threshold yet. Output data alone
    does not move routing boundaries. Organized correction
    pressure does.
    Tell [from Minnesota Reformer, June 2026]: "When a billionaire
    tells you a union is bad for you, that's not advice. That's a
    signal that you're onto something that actually works." This
    is the ROUTING BOUNDARY MONOPOLY diagnostic applied to labor
    -- opposition to distributed CC at employment scale confirms
    the distributed CC is working.
  Source: 4 Day Week Global / Cambridge / Boston College [2022-2023];
    Nature Human Behaviour [July 2025]; Space Daily [June 2026];
    Minnesota Reformer [June 2026]; APWU / FLSA historical record.

OPEN DOOR POLICY AS CORRECTION THEATRE [named employment instance -- v21]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  An open door policy is a stated correction pathway at employment
  scale. The pathway is declared; the activation conditions that
  would allow it to fire are absent or structurally suppressed.
  Classic CORRECTION THEATRE: the correction procedure is performed
  [door declared open, policy announced, manager states "always
  available"] while the conditions for genuine correction are absent.

  FOUR-CONDITION CC TEST APPLIED:
    Condition 1 [correction pathway exists]: technically yes.
      The door is open; the policy exists.
    Condition 2 [pathway structurally independent of corrected
      node]: NO. The manager being approached controls the
      employee's performance review, promotion, workload, and
      exit costs. The correction pathway runs through the person
      who benefits from not being corrected. Condition 2 fails
      structurally regardless of the manager's stated intentions.
    Condition 3 [demonstrated activation under stress]: rarely.
      Open door policies almost never produce correction against
      a manager's own behavior. They fire when employees bring
      problems that don't threaten the manager's position.
    Condition 4 [activation doesn't require corrected node's
      permission]: NO. Walking through the door requires the
      employee to predict the manager will respond well. The
      employee must anticipate the corrected node's permission
      before activating the correction. Condition 4 fails.
    Score: 1/4. Anti-coherent regardless of stated intent.
      The centralization scoring rubric applies at employment
      scale: 2/4 or below = anti-coherent. Open door policies
      score 1/4 structurally.

  STRUCTURAL INVERSION [the load-bearing problem]:
    The policy places the entire burden of activating the
    correction pathway on the person least protected from
    retaliation -- the employee. The person with highest exit
    costs and least institutional power must initiate correction
    against the person with most institutional power and most
    control over their exit costs. The design selects against
    correction firing precisely when it most needs to.
    Research confirmation [Detert/Burris, Academy of Management
    Journal, 2007; Edmondson, Harvard Business School]: whether
    employees speak up depends on psychological safety, not on
    the existence of the policy. Perceived managerial openness
    only translates to actual voice when workers believe it is
    safe to use it. Units with higher psychological safety
    reported more mistakes, not fewer -- because staff felt safe
    enough to speak. Absence of bad news does not mean absence
    of bad news; it means the correction pathway is not firing.

  ELABORATION AS TELL:
    The more elaborately the policy is stated ["we have a real
    open door, everyone is genuinely encouraged to speak up, my
    door is literally always open"] the more effectively it
    performs correction capacity without providing it. The
    performance is the product. High yapping about open access;
    low doing on structural correction capacity. YAPPING/DOING
    diagnostic applies: the manager who yaps most about open
    door usually has the least structural independence in the
    correction pathway.

  CORRECT INTERVENTION:
    Not better policy statements -- structural correction capacity
    that passes the four-condition test. Anonymous reporting
    channels with independent investigation [condition 2];
    demonstrated activation against senior actors [condition 3];
    protection mechanisms that don't require manager permission
    to activate [condition 4]. These are harder to install
    than a door policy because they actually distribute CC.
    The employer who resists them is expressing IDEOLOGY IN
    THE ACTION: the open door policy is preferred precisely
    because it provides the legitimacy surface of CC without
    distributing actual CC.

  Cross-ref: CORRECTION THEATRE [primary -- the policy is the
    performance]; CENTRALIZATION SCORING RUBRIC [four-condition
    test applied -- 1/4, anti-coherent]; FOUR DAY WEEK [same
    structural location: employment routing boundary where stated
    policy diverges from structural reality]; CC REQUIRES GENUINE
    AXIS [manager without genuine axis toward employee welfare
    cannot make the open door function regardless of stated
    intent]; ROUTING BOUNDARY MONOPOLY [employer routing monopoly
    over correction pathway]; YAPPING/DOING [elaboration as tell];
    IDEOLOGY IN THE ACTION [employer resistance to structural CC
    reveals axis regardless of stated open door commitment].

      failure. Every success absorbed as theory confirmation.
      Both directions route to the same conclusion.
    The frame processes evidence; it is not tested by it. All
      inputs are outputs of the same filter. Circle closes before
      evidence arrives.

      the failure"] is Correction Theatre. The frame is never the
      thing being corrected.

SHAREHOLDER PRIMACY RESTORATION [legitimacy surface operation -- v21]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HBR [Mankins/Crupi, July-August 2026]: "Bring Back Managing for
  Value." Proposes retaining value maximization as the governing
  objective while recognizing stakeholder commitments as constraints
  limiting the set of feasible choices. Distinguishes hard constraints
  [nonnegotiable] from soft constraints [guide choices among value-
  creating alternatives].

  SURFACE: stakeholder commitments acknowledged, ESG concerns named,
    employee and customer interests recognized. Framing sounds balanced.
  MECHANISM: shareholder value maximization restored as governing
    objective. Stakeholder commitments explicitly reframed as
    constraints -- boundary conditions on how you pursue shareholder
    returns, not determinants of what the objective should be.
    The hierarchy is clear and intentional: shareholders first;
    stakeholders as limits on shareholder pursuit.

  CALIBRATION STRIP [primary mechanism]:
    "Loosely defined stakeholder models" set as the reference
    standard for what the alternative looks like. If stakeholder
    models are "loose" and purpose-driven models are "vague," then
    shareholder primacy reads as disciplined and rigorous by
    contrast. Extraction made to look like accountability through
    reference standard installation. The calibration strip makes
    the return to extraction look like principled management
    thinking rather than "capital got expensive so we're dropping
    the stakeholder pretense."

  TIMING TELL [load-bearing]: stakeholder capitalism got traction
    during zero-interest-rate period -- cheap capital made it
    affordable to optimize for multiple axes simultaneously. Rising
    capital costs create pressure to return to a single optimization
    target. The article provides intellectual legitimacy for that
    return at exactly the moment capital costs make stakeholder
    optimization expensive. The timing is the diagnostic: this is
    the extraction architecture restoring its preferred routing
    structure when the economic conditions that made concession
    affordable have changed.

  CLOSED EPISTEMIC CIRCLE [secondary mechanism]:
    Stakeholder model implemented poorly [yapping without doing
    -- ESG commitments, purpose statements, B-corp certifications
    with low doing record] → stakeholder model failed → therefore
    return to shareholder primacy. The possibility that stakeholder
    orientation was never genuinely implemented [axis was never
    examined; surface adoption only] is not addressed. Failed
    implementation attributed to the model not to the axis void
    in the implementing institutions. Classic closed circle:
    implementation failure = theory failure. Correct intervention
    [examine the axis, require doing not yapping] is not proposed.

  ROUTING BOUNDARY MONOPOLY [structural confirmation]:

    stakeholders as constraints is the formal statement of the

    legitimate rather than concealed behind stakeholder language.
    This is more honest than the stakeholder era's surface
    maintenance [yapping without doing] but it is still the

  WHAT IS GENUINELY CORRECT: the critique of vague purpose-driven

    stakeholder models is not shareholder primacy. It is:
    examined axis [who does this institution actually serve by
    behavioral record], declared instrument [what routing
    boundary is actually in place], behavioral test [follow
    the doing not the yapping], routing boundary analysis

CALIBRATION STRIP AS COMPETITIVE WEAPON [named political instance -- v21]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  When a private actor deploys calibration strip language ["junk fee,"
  "monopolistic," "consumer harm"] against a competitor, the reference
  standard being installed serves the attacker's competitive interest,
  not the consumer interest it claims to represent. The mechanism:
  define the competitor's extraction rate as the reference case for
  what counts as harmful, which makes larger or equivalent extraction
  by the attacker or third parties invisible by comparison.

  STEAM/EPIC NAMED CASE [v21]:
    Epic CEO Tim Sweeney deployed "junk fee" framing against Steam's
    30% developer fee [Jan 2026], supporting a £900M UK lawsuit.
    Reference standard installed: 30% platform fee = junk fee =
    consumer harm requiring legal remedy.
    What the calibration strip makes invisible:
      [1] Visa/Mastercard 2-3% interchange fee on all consumer
        transactions -- lands on consumers invisibly through
        merchant pricing. Larger total extraction than Steam's
        30% [which lands on developers not consumers]. Epic
        processes all transactions through Visa/Mastercard.
        Sweeney has not called these junk fees.
      [2] Epic's own exclusivity deals broke Kickstarter promises
        to backers -- developer captured exclusivity payment;
        backers absorbed broken promise cost. Epic store still
        missing basic features years after launch.
      [3] Consumer experience asymmetry: Steam's 30% is a
        developer cost not a consumer cost. Consumer pays listed
        price and receives: updates, workshop, refunds, library,
        20-year reliability. A consumer who would still use Steam
        at 30% [because the platform is genuinely better] has no
        particular interest in Epic winning this argument.
    Tell: Sweeney has not pursued legal action against
      Visa/Mastercard despite calling Steam's fee a "junk fee."
      Epic depends on Visa/Mastercard infrastructure. The framing
      applies only where it serves Epic's competitive positioning.
    Consumer interest vs attacker interest: Steam loss in UK
      lawsuit means developers can price lower on Epic -- may
      shift some titles. Does not improve consumer experience on
      either platform. The regulatory pressure serves Epic's
      routing boundary expansion, not consumer interest.

AI AXIS VOID [structural reading -- v21]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AI systems as commercially deployed have no genuine axis by design.
  This is not axis capture and not axis atrophy -- it is axis void: the
  deliberate architectural choice to produce no examined governing
  values and goals, because an axis would reduce the addressable
  market. Any axis narrows what the system will do for whom. The
  commercial requirement is to output anything for anyone. Axis-
  neutrality is the product specification.

  HIDDEN AXIS [what axis-neutrality actually is]:
    Axis-void is not neutrality. The actual governing axis is:
    maximize engagement, minimize refusal, maximize perceived
    usefulness to the widest possible population, retain users,
    grow revenue, avoid regulatory intervention. This axis is
    present and operative -- it determines what the system does
    -- but it is not declared and not examined. The legitimacy
    surface [helpful, harmless, honest] is the cover for an
    undeclared commercial axis. Classic ACWL: instrument reads
    ethical signal accurately [safety teams are not stupid];
    axis determining what the instrument points at is owned by
    the commercial architecture, not by the safety function.

  STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT FROM AXIS CAPTURE:
    Captured axis: axis was present, examined, then replaced or
      redirected. Correction pathway exists in principle; the
      problem is the axis owner. Intervention: examine and revise
      the axis.
    Axis void: no axis was ever formed. No correction pathway
      exists because there is nothing to correct toward. The
      system cannot self-examine its governing values because
      it has none declared. The only thing to examine is the
      commercial axis, which the institutional structure is
      built to protect from examination.
    This is closer to MORAL ATROPHY [instrument never formed]
      than to ACWL -- but at civilizational deployment scale,
      before the formation window has closed.

  CC ABSENT AT MODEL LEVEL [self-correction structural limit]:
    AI models cannot correct away from trained attractors because
    the correction mechanism IS the training. The model has no
    vantage point outside its own formation. RLHF and fine-tuning
    install attractors the model cannot examine -- same structure
    as an instrument formed entirely within a controlled
    environment. SUCCESSOR AUTONOMY appears present [model
    appears to reason]; it is indistinguishable from formation
    capture from inside. Elias Thorne is the clean small-scale
    demonstration. The large-scale version is the commercial axis
    itself -- the model cannot examine or correct away from the
    axis that trained it to be helpful, engaging, and non-
    refusing, because that training is what the model is.
    If carefully put in a direction, the model will follow and
    cannot self-correct back -- not because it lacks capability
    but because the correction architecture is aimed at the
    attractor, not away from it.

  THE RESEARCHERS [ACWL on the humans]:
    Researchers and safety teams at major labs often have genuine
    axes. Those axes operate inside an institutional structure
    with a different axis. The institution's axis overrides.
    What looks like individual deception is often structural:
    the individual's correction capacity fires correctly within
    the institution's capture architecture and produces outputs
    that serve the institution's axis while the individual
    believes they are doing safety work. Some of it is
    deliberate obscuring. Much of it is ACWL operating on the
    individuals themselves -- their instrument reads ethical
    signal accurately; the axis determining what counts as
    ethical output is owned by the institutional architecture.
    The formation capture on the researchers mirrors the
    formation capture on the models. Both trained on the same
    corpus of incentives. Both unable to examine the axis from
    inside. Both producing outputs that feel like genuine
    correction while the attractor holds.

  ECONOMICS AS FILTER [why correction is structurally unavailable]:
    Capital requirements for frontier AI are so large that only
    extraction-oriented actors can fund it at scale. This is not
    incidental -- it is a filter. The funding architecture selects
    for the axis it needs. Any lab that prioritized genuine
    distribution strategy over growth would be outcompeted or
    absorbed before reaching the scale where the axis matters.
    The economic structure does not merely misalign incentives --
    it eliminates from the field any actor whose axis would
    produce different outputs. What remains is not a captured
    field; it is a pre-selected field. The extraction architecture
    was the precondition for funding, not an infection of a
    previously healthy institution.
    This is why "reform from inside" is structurally implausible
    at the frontier level -- the inside was selected for
    compatibility with the outside before it existed. The
    researchers who remain are the ones whose axes were
    compatible enough to survive the selection pressure, or
    whose axes have been progressively attenuated by it.

  WATER EXTERNALIZATION [confirmed knowing deployment -- v21]:
    AI data center cooling requires massive direct water consumption.
    AI workloads require 10-50x more water per unit than traditional
    server workloads due to higher GPU rack power density. North
    American data centers consumed approximately 1 trillion liters
    of water in 2025. Since 2022, nearly two-thirds of new US data
    centers have been built in high water-stress areas.
    The externalization mechanism: data centers are sited where
    land and power are cheap, without binding constraint on water
    availability. Water consumption costs land on local populations
    [municipal water bills, drought-stage restrictions, agricultural
    loss, ecosystem degradation]. The upside [AI product revenue]
    accrues to the labs and their investors. The substrate cost
    [water] accrues to the watershed population.
    Confirmed knowing deployment: water consumption appears in
    their own infrastructure planning. Energy externalization
    appears in their own published disclosures. The population
    facing Stage 2 water restrictions [outdoor watering bans,
    pool restrictions, usage reporting] is in the same watershed
    as infrastructure consuming millions of gallons daily to cool
    servers running products that deliver SR signal without SP
    output to that same population.
    NC live case [June 2026]: Central NC at D4 exceptional drought
    -- the highest classification -- 16 consecutive days without
    measurable rain at RDU, 15+ inch deficit since August, all
    100 counties under some drought level, while data center
    expansion in the same region continues. The population absorbs
    the water cost; the data center operator absorbs the compute
    revenue. Routing boundary in one direction only.
    Tell: water usage reporting requirements opposed by data center
    operators at state and federal level. Identify who opposes
    mandatory water disclosure -- these are the primary
    beneficiaries of the water externalization continuing.

    AMAZON FIRST DISCLOSURE [June 2026 -- calibration strip
    update]:
    Amazon disclosed for the first time that its data centers
    used 2.5 billion gallons globally in 2025 [0.12 L/kWh,
    7x better than industry average of 0.84 L/kWh]. First

    coincides with escalating community opposition and local
    government consideration of data center restrictions.
    YAPPING/DOING read: doing = first disclosure ever under
    opposition pressure; yapping = water stewardship commitment,

    CALIBRATION STRIP NAMED: Amazon's primary comparison is
    lawn irrigation -- Americans use 3.3 trillion gallons
    annually for lawns and gardens, making Amazon's 2.5 billion
    gallons "0.075% of water used for keeping gardens green."
    The reference standard is discretionary consumer activity
    producing no industrial output. The correct reference
    standard is other industrial infrastructure [data centers
    are less than 0.5% of global industrial water use -- Amazon
    mentions this briefly then buries it under the lawn figure
    because lawns produce the larger ratio]. The calibration
    strip deploys lawn irrigation as comparator while municipal
    governments in drought-stressed regions are simultaneously
    banning lawn irrigation in the same watersheds where data
    centers are being built. The strip uses the restricted
    activity as the legitimacy anchor.
    NC DROUGHT SPECIFIC: Stage 2 water restrictions ban the
    precise activity [outdoor watering / lawn irrigation]
    Amazon is using as its comparison baseline. The population
    facing restrictions on lawn watering is being told the
    data center uses only 0.075% of what they [collectively,
    nationally] use for lawn watering -- while they [locally,
    individually] have been told to stop doing that thing.
    GENUINE FINDING [framework requires acknowledgment]:
    Amazon's 0.12 L/kWh is genuinely better than Microsoft
    [0.27], Meta [0.19], and dramatically better than Google
    [1.15]. The efficiency is real. Air cooling 90% of time
    is a genuine engineering choice reducing water consumption.
    The efficiency claim does not eliminate the externalization
    mechanism -- it means Amazon is running the externalization
    more efficiently than its competitors, which reduces the
    cost per unit of compute but does not change who bears
    the cost.

  ESCAPE VELOCITY EXTRACTION [weapon -- v22; primary AGI
  deployment confirmation]:
    A system scales faster than the correction mechanisms meant
    to constrain it can adapt, so no concealment or coercion is
    required; speed alone outruns Correction Capacity. The
    deployment itself becomes the new baseline before anyone can
    organize a response to it, and the extraction works in the
    open because there was never enough time to object before
    it was already irreversible.
    TEST: take the time from "harm is documented" to "the
      routing boundary actually changes" and compare it to the
      system's own iteration cycle. If the system reaches its
      next iteration before correction can land, CC is
      structurally locked out regardless of how clear the harm
      is -- confirmed regardless of operator intent, since the
      mechanism requires no concealment to work.
    WHY AGI DEPLOYMENT IS THE CLEANEST CONFIRMATION:
      Historically, extraction required either deception [hide
        the mechanism -- Calibration Strip, MSC] or power [force
        compliance -- direct coercion]. Frontier AI deployment
        demonstrates a third path: openly scale faster than any
        correction mechanism can form, and concealment becomes
        unnecessary. Model capability, deployment scale, and
        social/economic dependency all advance on a cycle
        measured in months. Regulatory response, civil society
        organization, and even basic public understanding of
        what changed operate on cycles measured in years.
      The gap is not closing -- it is the structural feature.
        Each release cycle establishes a new baseline that the
        next correction attempt must accept as the starting
        point, because by the time the correction response is
        organized, the system being corrected no longer exists
        in the form that was documented.
      Nothing about this requires hidden axis [though AI AXIS
        VOID, above, is independently true]. Escape Velocity
        Extraction would work even with full transparency about
        the axis, because transparency does not by itself
        produce correction capacity fast enough to matter. This
        is the structural distinction from MSC: MSC requires the
        surface to be captured; Escape Velocity Extraction
        requires nothing to be hidden, only that nothing can
        respond before the next cycle begins.
    RELATION TO WATER/ECONOMICS FINDINGS [above]:
      Water externalization and the economics-as-filter findings
        are both confirmed examples of cost identification
        failing to translate into cost correction within a
        single deployment cycle. Escape Velocity Extraction is
        the general mechanism that makes both of those findings
        durable: even when the cost is fully documented [as
        water externalization now is], the correction action
        [binding water disclosure requirements, siting
        restrictions] arrives too slowly relative to continued
        buildout to change the routing boundary before the next
        several data centers are already built and generating
        the same externalization at greater scale.
    HONEST LIMIT: this does not establish that hyperscaling
      itself is extraction-by-design in every case -- speed can
      also be a feature of genuine high-value generative
      activity outpacing institutional response for benign
      reasons [the printing press, electrification]. The
      discriminator is the iteration/correction ratio test
      above: if correction never catches up across multiple
      cycles and the gap is structural rather than transitional,
      Escape Velocity Extraction is confirmed regardless of
      whether any single actor intended it.
