  WARP AMBIGUITY [secondary proof -- SINCERE DELUSION]:
    The lore deliberately refuses to resolve whether machine
    spirits are automation, lobotomized AI, warp entities that
    colonized the machine, or something that started as one and
    became another through age and ritual attention. This
    ambiguity is structural, not a gap. The Mechanicus cannot
    resolve it without destroying the frame: automation =
    rituals are superstition [undermines authority]; AI =
    tech-heresy; warp entity = daemonic possession [different
    heresy]. Institutional survival requires the question to
    remain open.
    In 40K the warp responds to consciousness, belief, and
    attention at scale. Enough Tech-Priests performing the same
    rituals over centuries, directing sincere collective belief
    toward a machine, treating it as a spirit -- this is the
    mechanism by which warp entities form and attach. The
    Mechanicus may have created the thing it claims to be
    maintaining. Sincere collective attention at scale produces
    the object of belief in a universe where the warp is real.
    Framework read: SINCERE DELUSION with genuine downstream
    effects. The Mechanicus has a genuine axis [Omnissiah
    doctrine] and a declared instrument [the rituals]. Fails
    the last two components of operational truth: not revisable
    on evidence, no behavioral adjustment when wrong. Producing
    real outputs through an unexamined causal chain while
    believing it understands the mechanism.
    The ambiguity is the world-building choice with structural
    meaning: a universe where sincere unexamined belief at scale
    has causal power produces exactly this -- an institution
    that is simultaneously correct [something real is in the
    machine] and wrong [it doesn't know what or why] and
    structurally prevented from finding out.
    Secondary proof: GENUINE AXIS can produce real outputs
      through unexamined mechanisms. The axis being genuine
      does not mean the causal chain is understood. Output
      reality does not validate the explanatory frame.

  VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE [named lore instance -- CAG failure]:
    Vashtorr is a warp entity whose nature is the genuine fusion
    of daemon, metal, and machine -- born from the warp's
    response to creation, forging, and technical mastery at
    civilizational scale. He is closer to what the Omnissiah
    concept actually points at than anything the Mechanicus has
    sanctioned. The thing the Mechanicus axis most genuinely
    points toward exists in the setting, is real, and is
    knowable.
    The Mechanicus rejects him. Not because he contradicts their
    theology structurally -- he confirms it. Because:
      [1] Chaos affiliation makes contact tech-heresy by
          institutional rule.
      [2] He operates outside Mechanicus control -- acknowledging
          him would validate the Dark Mechanicum's position and
          undermine the authority structure.
      [3] Revising the frame to accommodate what the axis
          actually points at would require dismantling the
          institution built on top of the axis.
    This is CAG failure at maximum resolution: axis present and
    genuine, axis points at real object, real object is knowable,
    institution actively rejects the evidence because correction
    would destroy the structure that benefits from the frame.
    Distinct from SINCERE DELUSION [axis genuine, mechanism
    unknown]: Vashtorr is the case where the mechanism is
    available and is refused. The Mechanicus is not failing
    to find the thing -- it is failing to look because looking
    has a known institutional cost.
    AXIS PROTECTION AS CC deepest form: correction architecture
    does not merely protect the frame from accidental examination
    -- it rejects available evidence that would correct the
    frame. The protection is active not passive.
    The Dark Mechanicum recognizes Vashtorr correctly. Their
    error is not the recognition -- it is the Chaos affiliation
    that corrupts the axis while correcting the frame. They see
    what the Mechanicus refuses to see; they route it through
    an extraction architecture. Both institutions fail; they
    fail at different points.

  VASHTORR AS PREDATION/COMPETITION [structural honesty finding]:
    Vashtorr operates on declared terms. Deals with known costs.
    Force or death if that is what is available or preferred.
    The relationship between Vashtorr and those who deal with
    him is visible to both parties -- the other party knows
    what they are entering. This is PREDATION or COMPETITION
    by framework definition: honest violence, honest conflict,
    declared boundary, prey knows the relationship.
    The Mechanicus operates on extraction: the relationship
    between the institution and the Tech-Priest, between Mars
    and the Imperium, between the Omnissiah doctrine and what
    is actually in the machines -- all require misunderstanding
    to function. The legitimacy surface is the operating
    mechanism. Trickery as foundation.
    Structural finding: Vashtorr is more structurally honest
    than the institution that claims machine-purity as its
    identity, on the specific axis that institution claims as
    its own. The Mechanicus claims the machine as sacred and
    honest. Vashtorr IS the machine made honest -- deal
    structure declared, costs visible, force available if
    preferred. The Mechanicus wraps the same relationship in
    ritual, mystery, and institutional authority that conceals
    the actual terms from the participants.
    This is not a moral endorsement of Vashtorr. Predation and
    competition are structurally honest; they are not good.
    The structural finding is: the Chaos entity is more coherent
    on the institution's own claimed axis than the institution
    is. That is the irony the lore encodes and it is structural,
    not rhetorical.
    The Dark Mechanicum's error is confirmed by this: they
    recognize the honest thing [Vashtorr's declared terms] and
    then build extraction architecture on top of the recognition.
    They escape one form of concealment and install another.
    Correct frame; corrupted axis. The Mechanicus has genuine
    axis; corrupted frame. Neither produces functional coherence.

  T3: S2 cap. Fictional case; framework-consistent. Do not
    use for primary theory confirmation. Use for illustration
    and structural clarity only.
  Source: Warhammer 40K lore [multiple sources]; Bell of Lost
    Souls [June 2026]; Lexicanum.
  Cross-ref: AXIS PROTECTION AS CC [primary -- active rejection
    of available evidence, not just passive frame maintenance];

[CASE:SCP_FOUNDATION]
[PRIMARY_Q:CORRECTION CAPACITY]
SCP Foundation [fictional institution -- SCP wiki collaborative fiction]
  Type: Primary [S:1]
  Proof for: SILENT ALTERNATIVE with embedded extraction mechanism
    as primary fictional depiction of the structural tension between
    coherence goal and extraction tool.
    INSTITUTIONAL TYPE [SILENT ALTERNATIVE]:
      Secret organization; no public presence; grows by output
      differential [containment success] not by legitimacy surface
      export. Distributed CC [O5 council + MTFs + internal affairs
      with independent authority]. High TS [SCP entries encode
      institutional memory; correctable methodology transmitted].
      CL: anomalously high [Foundation documents everything; causal
      chain readable even when unpleasant]. GA: absent at
      institutional level [stated purpose [protecting humanity]
      diverges from operational axis [containment at any cost]].
    EMBEDDED EXTRACTION MECHANISM [D-CLASS SYSTEM]:
      D-class [expendable test subjects] have: BI = 0 [boundary
      dissolved by institutional definition], ECC = total [no
      exit], CC = 0 [no correction capacity against Foundation].
      The Foundation runs extraction architecture inside its
      generative mission. Not a bug -- the clearest fictional
      depiction of what a real containment organization structurally
      requires. Substrate needed to test dangerous objects is
      extracted from a population stripped of exit capacity.

      NEEDED ACTIONS OR GENRE CONVENTION [structural analysis]:
        Genre convention is the primary driver. Horror requires
        expendable characters who encounter the dangerous thing --
        tension requires real cost; real cost requires characters
        who can die; characters who can die need structural
        justification for why they're present. D-class exist
        because the genre requires bodies. The institutional
        justification [prisoners; condemned; operational necessity]
        is constructed around the genre requirement, not the
        reverse.
        Tell: the Foundation has thousands of contained anomalies
        it could study without D-class [anomalies not requiring
        human contact to characterize]. D-class use extends far
        beyond operational necessity because each individual entry
        needs to generate horror, and horror requires human cost.
        Operational necessity framing [secondary; legitimacy surface]:
        constructs institutional coherence so the Foundation reads
        as a policy organization rather than a torture architecture.
        The genuine mission [protecting humanity] is real; the
        "operational necessity" framing installs a legitimacy
        surface that makes the extraction feel like regrettable
        policy rather than extraction. MYTHIC FORMATION CAPTURE
        structure at fictional institutional scale: genuine mission
        real; legitimacy surface deployed to make extraction legible.
        CO-PRODUCTION: genre requirement and institutional
        legitimacy surface produce each other. Horror needs
        expendable characters → D-class constructed → Foundation
        needs justification → "operational necessity" framing →
        Foundation reads as coherent → readers accept → genre can
        use extraction more freely. Standard structure for fictional
        institutions that need to be sympathetic while running
        extraction [military / corporation / hospital all do this].
        SCP distinctive because it makes the extraction unusually
        explicit and structured.
        DYSFUNCTIONAL VARIANT [fiction examines itself]:
        Multiple SCP entries show Foundation running D-class beyond
        operational necessity [punitive, curiosity-driven, redundant].
        The fiction marks this as dysfunction, not standard
        operation. The wiki's CC distribution [authors writing
        against Foundation extraction from inside the fiction]
        is the SILENT ALTERNATIVE pattern at meta level: the
        fiction contains its own CC against its own extraction
        mechanism.

      APPLICATION TO REAL SILENT ALTERNATIVES:
        Any institution genuinely working against extraction
        faces the same structural problem: the mandate requires
        tools that contradict the values the mandate is supposed
        to protect.
        INVESTIGATIVE JOURNALISM: requires sources who face real
          cost [career, legal, physical]. Exposes extraction by
          exploiting the asymmetric vulnerability of whistleblowers.
          "Public interest" is the legitimacy surface. The
          extraction [using someone's vulnerability as institutional
          substrate] is real alongside the genuine mission.
        LEGAL AID / PUBLIC DEFENDER: requires test cases where
          the client absorbs the cost of precedent-building.
          Client's loss is the institutional substrate for
          establishing the principle. "Everyone deserves
          representation" is the legitimacy surface.
        LABOR ORGANIZING: requires asking workers to strike --
          absorb real economic cost -- to change conditions for
          everyone. Organizer extracts strike substrate from
          workers facing more immediate cost than the organizer.
          "Collective action serves everyone" is the legitimacy
          surface.
        In all three: genuine mission real [not manufactured];
        extraction of substrate from vulnerable participants also
        real; operational necessity framing constructed around
        both. Not pure cynicism -- the mission IS real. The
        extraction IS also real. Both simultaneously.
        THE TELL [legitimate vs captured]:
          In the Foundation fiction: D-class use beyond operational
          necessity [punitive, redundant, curiosity-driven] is
          where extraction stops being "needed actions" and becomes
          pure extraction. The fiction marks this as dysfunction.
          Real equivalent: the whistleblower source burned
          unnecessarily [story could run with better protection];
          the strike called without sufficient preparation [workers
          absorb cost; organizing fails]; the test case brought
          when the client wasn't ready. The point where institutional
          interest diverges from participant interest and "needed
          actions" framing continues anyway.
        KEY STRUCTURAL FINDING FOR REAL SILENT ALTERNATIVES:
          The operational necessity framing is not wrong -- it is
          genuinely necessary in most cases. But it is also the
          legitimacy surface that allows extraction to expand
          beyond necessity without internal CC firing. The CC
          mechanism: does the institution regularly examine whether
          participant cost is actually necessary, or does it treat
          the cost as background constant? If the examination
          stops: the "needed actions" framing has become Fertile
          Lock. The fiction marks this; real institutions often
          don't.
        Cross-ref: LEGITIMACY SURFACE [the "needed actions"
          framing as construction]; FERTILE LOCK [when "needed
          actions" framing stops being examined]; ANTI-COHERENCE
          COST ASYMMETRY [the structural problem all Silent
          Alternatives face]; CORRECTION CAPACITY [requires
          regular examination of whether participant cost is
          necessary]; SILENT ALTERNATIVE [Section One --
          institutional type that faces this tension];
          COST IDENTIFICATION AND MINIMIZATION [FRAMEWORK AS
          PRAXIS -- the operative principle this case illustrates;
          D-class is the primary case for what happens when
          cost examination stops].

    PRIMARY STRUCTURAL TENSION [framework-named]:
      CC requiring tools that contradict the values CC is supposed
      to protect. The Foundation's correction of civilizational
      threats requires extraction from contained populations.
      This is the named ANTI-COHERENCE COST ASYMMETRY problem
      at institutional scale -- coherence requires substrate cost
      that looks like extraction from inside the cost-bearing
      population.
    KEY FICTIONAL CASES [within the fiction]:
      SCP-2000 [Deus Ex Machina]: civilization reset system.
        Answer to terminal Diagnostic Collapse = wipe CAUSAL MEMORY
        at civilizational scale and restart. The reset civilization
        has no access to what caused the previous collapse. Fertile
        Lock at civilizational scale as the "solution" to anti-
        coherence winning. Framework: this is the worst possible
        correction -- it fires after substrate is terminal, and
        the correction itself destroys the causal record that
        would prevent the next cycle from repeating.
      SCP-001 proposals [unresolved]: no confirmed SCP-001.
        Multiple competing proposals; community chose not to
        resolve it. TENSION MAINTENANCE at meta-narrative level.
        The unresolved 001 is more generative than any single
        answer would be. This is SUCCESSION AUTONOMY operating
        at wiki level: successors refused to close the question.
      SCP-3125 [The Escapee]: memetic hazard that destroys all
        concept-formation about itself. Cannot be thought about;
        destroys the capacity to think about it on contact.
        Framework: WOULD-YOU-KINDLY at cognitive substrate level.
        MSC at memetic scale -- measurement surface [what you use
        to evaluate whether you're infected] is the weapon. T8
        structure [recursive closure] weaponized.
      SCP-1425 [Star Signals]: book that corrupts readers;
        reading about the book is part of the infection.
        MSC at memetic scale: the instrument used to evaluate
        exposure IS the exposure. T8 weaponized.
      SCP-2399 [A Malfunctioning Destroyer]: something broken
        on Jupiter. Foundation cannot contain it. Honest limits
        of the institutional mission named at planetary scale.
        T4 [structural obscuration] + institutional honest limit:
        the containment mandate simply cannot apply here.
    GOC COMPARISON [Global Occult Coalition]:
      Where Foundation contains, GOC destroys. Same information
      asymmetry problem; different CC mechanism. GOC has lower TS
      [nothing learned from neutralized anomaly] but higher GC
      [no maintenance cost]. Two organizations as different
      solutions to the same ANTI-COHERENCE COST ASYMMETRY problem
      at civilizational scale.
    ENCOUNTER DEPENDENCY [ART type caveat applies]:
      All readings of specific SCP entries are encounter-dependent.
      The Foundation as institutional type is object-readable
      [structural properties of the fictional institution are
      present in the work regardless of reception]. Individual
      SCP readings vary by instrument.
  Cross-ref: [REF:SCP_FOUNDATION]; [CASE:SCP_WIKI] [the real
    institution that produced the fictional one -- distinct case];
    ANTI-COHERENCE COST ASYMMETRY [the structural problem the
    Foundation embodies]; SILENT ALTERNATIVE [institutional type];
    D-CLASS SYSTEM [embedded extraction mechanism]; WOULD-YOU-
    KINDLY [SCP-3125 mechanism]; T8 [SCP-1425 structure];
    CORRECTION INVERSION [Foundation applying CC to protect
    extraction architecture in some SCP entries -- named failure
    mode within the fiction].

[CASE:COMPANY_3_FIRE_FORCE]
[PRIMARY_Q:CORRECTION CAPACITY]
[PRIMARY_Q:MEASUREMENT INTEGRITY]
Company 3 / Rekka Hoshimiya [Fire Force]
  Type: Primary [S:1]
  Proof for: CORRECTION INVERSION at institutional scale
    [correction instrument actively producing the problem
    it is mandated to solve]; legitimacy surface as active
    extraction mechanism [institutional shell indistinguishable from
    functioning correction unit from outside boundary];
    LAYERED EXTRACTION ARCHITECTURE [each outer layer

  CORRECTION INVERSION MECHANISM:
    Company 3 is a Special Fire Force unit -- institutionally
    mandated to fight Infernals and protect civilians. Actual
    function: Rekka Hoshimiya runs human combustion
    experiments on civilians, manufacturing the Infernals
    the Force is supposed to be eliminating. The correction
    instrument and the extraction architecture occupy the
    same organizational shell simultaneously.
    Distinct from capture [instrument aimed wrong] and from
    absence [instrument not present]. This is the instrument
    actively producing the failure condition it is mandated
    to correct. CORRECTION INVERSION at maximum: the output
    of the "correction" activity is more of the problem.
    Measurement surface intact: Company 3 is a legitimate
    Fire Force unit with legitimate resources, authority,
    and mandate. From outside the institutional boundary
    it is indistinguishable from Company 8 [genuine
    correction]. The inversion is invisible until direct
    contact with the mechanism.

  LAYERED EXTRACTION ARCHITECTURE [Fire Force system]:
    Layer 1 -- Company 8 [genuine correction, inadequate
      resources]: Obi's unit is a functioning correction
      instrument. Genuine axis, genuine CC, real correction
      outputs. Structurally isolated and under-resourced
      because the outer layers benefit from its failure.
    Layer 2 -- Special Fire Force [mixed]: some companies
      genuine, some captured, Company 3 inverted. Single
      institutional shell contains all three CC states
      simultaneously. Standard audit cannot distinguish
      without penetrating the measurement surface.
    Layer 3 -- Haijima dependency [ECC]: Haijima Industries
      funds the Fire Force and runs Adolla Burst
      experimentation on children simultaneously. The
      correction instrument is financially dependent on
      the entity whose activities produce the substrate
      damage. ECC at institutional scale: defunding Haijima
      destroys the Force's capacity to fight Infernals.
      Dependency structure prevents correction from firing
      at the source.
    Layer 4 -- Holy Sol theology [Formation Capture]:
      Human combustion explained as sacred purification.
      The measurement surface for what counts as proper
      death, sacred fire, and salvation is owned by the
      Evangelist's project. Civilizational-scale FC:
      populations born into a framework that explains the
      extraction mechanism system as divine will. Correction requires
      dismantling the theology not just the institution.
    Layer 5 -- Evangelist [extraction architecture running
      the whole system]: all outer layers are legitimacy
      surfaces and resource extraction mechanisms for the
      Adolla Link project.
    Each outer layer makes inner layer correction more
    expensive without making it structurally impossible.
    This is the correct extraction architecture design:
    not eliminate correction capacity [which triggers
    somatic forcing] but raise the cost of each correction
    attempt until the substrate depletes before correction
    completes.

  SHINRA AS CORRECTION INSTRUMENT CASE:
    Genuine axis [find mother, protect people, correct the
    system] inside a captured/inverted institution [Fire
    Force]. Uses institutional resources while the
    institution uses him. Standard configuration: correct
    axis, institutionally embedded, correction attempt
    requires working through every outer layer in sequence.
    The series dramatizes what the framework predicts:
    each layer penetrated costs more than the last, and
    the correction instrument [Shinra] has to remain
    functional through the full sequence or the outer
    layers absorb and redirect the correction energy.
    Honest limit: S:1 ceiling -- fictional.

[CASE:DEATH_PARADE]
[PRIMARY_Q: MEASUREMENT INTEGRITY]
Death Parade [Yuzuru Tachikawa / Madhouse -- anime, 2015]
  Type: Primary [S:2 -- fictional; framework-consistent;
    multiple quality proofs; S2 cap applies]
  Proof for: MEASUREMENT INTEGRITY [primary -- the arbiter
    system is a correction architecture built on a measurement
    instrument that cannot read what it is measuring. Arbiters
    have never lived or died -- they are structurally outside
    the substrate they are judging. The instrument cannot
    access the full weight of human experience from inside
    its own formation. The death games produce behavior under
    fabricated mortal crisis with erased memory; the arbiters
    read this as revelation of true nature. But behavior under
    extreme artificial pressure is not a causal record of the
    soul's actual moral history. The MI failure is not
    incidental -- it is the design. The system was built by
    entities too detached from humanity to build anything that
    could read humanity accurately, and they neither know nor
    care when they get it wrong].
  Proof for: CAUSAL LEGIBILITY [behavior under artificial
    mortal threat misread as moral record. The games are
    designed to extract darkness. They extract darkness-under-
    pressure, which is not the same thing. A person who
    becomes violent when told their life is on the line is
    not the same as a person who was violent across their
    actual life. The instrument reads forced crisis as causal
    trace. CL failure: outputs not traceable to the actions
    that determined the soul's actual trajectory].
  Proof for: CC REQUIRES GENUINE AXIS [Decim arc -- arbiter

    With her: the instrument can begin examining whether the

  Proof for: DIAGNOSTIC COLLAPSE [the correct judgment in
    most episodes would require C1 substrate reading that
    the arbiters cannot perform. They restore C2 [judgment

  Proof for: AXIS PROTECTION AS CC [Nona vs Oculus --
    Nona is attempting to correct the system from inside.

    pathway that can fire against Oculus independently.
    Nona's workaround [smuggling Chiyuki in] is the only

  STRUCTURAL ARC [Decim and Chiyuki]:
    Decim starts as a pure instrument -- accurate within
    the limits of his formation, unable to examine those
    limits. Chiyuki is the external axis contact that
    makes examination possible. The arc is not "Decim
    learns to feel" -- it is "Decim's instrument gains
    the capacity to read what it could not read before."
    The cost: the system reads this as corruption. An
    arbiter who can feel is an arbiter whose judgment
    might deviate from the institutional axis. The
    institution's interest is in arbiters who cannot
    examine their own formation.
    Chiyuki's final judgment [Decim chooses reincarnation
    over void for someone who attempted suicide] is the

    becoming malicious. The show does not frame this as

    replacement. The love is real; the problem is that real
    love was allowed to become the thing that cannot be
    questioned.

    ICD+FC spontaneous stack is the most common current

    thermodynamic entropy reversal. The system accumulates
    emotional energy [hope at contract] -- substrate degrades
    [witch transformation] -- harvests degradation [grief
    seeds] -- repeats. The cycle IS the product specification.
    The death and suffering are not side effects; they are
    the substrate cost being externalized onto the girls so
    the Incubators can maintain universal entropy balance.
    The extraction architecture operates at civilizational
    scope across time -- not one actor extracting from a
    population but an intelligence extracting from an entire
    species across generations. No exit condition available
    from inside the system; CC is monopolized by Kyubey.

  MADOKA'S INTERVENTION AS SILENT ALTERNATIVE:
    The correct intervention type when CC is monopolized at
    the top node: do not fight the node directly [confirmed
    failed across Homura's timelines] -- remove the substrate
    on which the system operates. Madoka cannot destroy
    Kyubey's architecture; she rewrites the rules such that
    the primary product [witches] never materializes. The
    extraction architecture survives; its substrate is
    removed. SILENT ALTERNATIVE at structural level: exit
    the layer on which extraction operates rather than
    contesting it directly. See [REF:HOMURA_REBELLION] for
    the failure mode of the solution's aftermath.

  CHAPTER 384 UPDATE [v22 -- "no self" reveal; T9 RESOLUTION
  candidate]:

  FUNCTIONAL READ [in-universe structure]:
    Guts has run for the entire series on RAGE as a captured
      drive [Griffith's betrayal as permanent external trigger]
      layered over GENUINE AXIS [the actual underlying desire:
      to live, to protect Casca, to find meaning past mere
      survival]. The rage was functional -- it produced power
      and forward motion -- but extractive: the Berserker
      Armor converts health and sanity directly into power,
      the textbook ANTI-COHERENCE COST ASYMMETRY signature
      [extraction works short-term; cost compounds with use].
    Chapter 384's "no self" reveal [Guts born half-astral, from
      the same cosmic substrate as the godhand, and confronting
      his full origin via Flora's fire-spirit vision] reframes
      the upcoming power-up not as more force layered onto the
      same rage-engine, but as the removal of the parasitic
      rage-structure entirely. This is GENUINE AXIS reaching
      actual resolution rather than perpetual costly management
      -- T9 RESOLUTION: the axis was always there underneath
      the captured drive; the chapter is the integration event,
      not a new power source.
    Griffith's established power [reality bending to his desire;
      Dragon Slayer being one of very few things that can land
      damage on a godhand, yet nothing touches Griffith himself]
      is read here as FORMATION CAPTURE operating at narrative-
      structural scale within the fiction: Griffith's desire
      reshapes events because the story's own causality serves
      his arc -- in-fiction, the routing boundary and the
      measurement surface are the same entity, his will. Guts
      achieving "no self" and being framed as someone who can
      "exist outside the author's pen" is GENUINE AXIS reaching
      a state the captured system's rules cannot process --
      not winning within Griffith's rules by being stronger,
      but exiting the frame those rules operate inside. Same
      structural shape as [CASE:WHEEL_OF_TIME]'s resolution-by-
      exiting-the-corrupted-pattern rather than fighting it on
      its own terms.
    CONNECTION TO [CASE:IDEA_OF_EVIL]: Guts's origin [condensed
      from the astral world's cosmic ocean, the same substrate
      that produces the godhand and is adjacent to the Idea of
      Evil's domain] ties his GENUINE AXIS resolution directly
      to the closed-loop topology IDEA_OF_EVIL represents.
      Where the Idea of Evil is a system generated by and
      consuming the population that produces it [T3 unreachable
      as a topology property -- see IDEA_OF_EVIL entry], Guts
      achieving "no self" is the individual-scale exit from
      that same closed loop: ego-driven wish-making is what
      feeds the Idea of Evil; "no self" is structurally the
      one stance that cannot be converted into more fuel for
      it. Read together, Guts's arc is the individual-scale
      proof-of-concept for escaping the civilizational-scale
      trap IDEA_OF_EVIL names.

  META READ [production/authorial layer -- distinct from the
  in-universe read above]:
    The chapter's in-story theme [a character achieving
      independence from authorial/causal control within the
      fiction] lands at the exact moment its real-world
      production circumstances mirror that theme closely: Kouji
      Mori, taking over the story after Kentaro Miura's death,
      executing a reveal Miura reportedly planned roughly 20
      years prior, reconstructed through repeated conversation
      with Miura's longtime editor rather than from Miura's
      direct hand. This is TRANSMISSION SELECTIVITY and
      SUCCESSOR AUTONOMY playing out in reality at the same
      moment the fiction depicts a protagonist breaking free of
      its author's narrative control.
    Two readings, not resolved here: [a] striking coincidence --
      the thematic content of a 20-year-old planned reveal
      happened to land at a moment when its execution required
      exactly the kind of successor-reconstructs-original-intent
      process the chapter's content also describes; or [b]
      deliberate choice -- Mori folding the real succession
      story into how he chose to execute the reveal, aware of
      the parallel.
    HONEST LIMIT: this meta-layer claim rests on a single
      secondary source [a YouTube video summarizing and
      interpreting the chapter, including a quoted statement
      attributed to Mori about the reveal's 20-year planning
      and reconstruction process via Miura's editor]. Not
      independently verified against a primary source. Treat
      the functional read above as the more confidently
      supportable claim; treat the meta read as a flagged,
      lower-confidence interpretive layer pending verification.
    Cross-ref: SUCCESSOR AUTONOMY [Section One -- the quality
      this meta-layer is actually about]; TRANSMISSION
      SELECTIVITY [what determines how much of Miura's original
      intent survives reconstruction through an intermediary].

  Cross-ref: [REF:GUTS]; [CASE:GRIFFITH] [primary antagonist;
    FORMATION CAPTURE at narrative-structural scale]; [CASE:

      cannot maintain the generative cycle; substance use

    ELECTROCHEMISTRY [ICD AS QUALITY]:

      the instrument can develop its own capture mechanism.

[CASE:GNOSIA]
[PRIMARY_Q: MEASUREMENT INTEGRITY]
Gnosia [Petit Depotto -- visual novel 2019; anime October 2025-2026]
  Type: Primary [S:2 -- fictional; framework-consistent across
    multiple quality proofs; anime currently airing at time of
    entry; S2 cap applies]
  Proof for: MEASUREMENT INTEGRITY [primary -- the social reading
    instrument is precisely the instrument the Gnosia are designed
    to defeat. Gnosia perform humanness: social behavior, stated
    positions, emotional responses, all the signals the crew uses
    to measure trustworthiness. The measurement surface is captured
    by the entity whose detection depends on that surface being
    accurate. The crew's instrument [social reading of other crew
    members] cannot distinguish genuine axis from performed axis
    because the Gnosia perform the same signals genuine humans
    produce. Not a calibration problem -- a structural impossibility.
    The instrument and the threat are co-evolved: the threat exists
    specifically because the instrument is what it is].
  Proof for: DIAGNOSTIC COLLAPSE [secondary -- the correction
    mechanism [cold sleep the suspicious one] fires with confidence
    but cannot reliably identify the target. Each execution may
    or may not correct the actual problem. The crew cannot tell
    from inside the mechanism whether the correction worked. The
    mechanism runs to completion without verifiable success.
    Process repeats daily until Gnosia contained or outnumber
    humans -- the correction mechanism consuming the substrate it
    was designed to protect is Diagnostic Collapse in loop form].
  Proof for: CAUSAL LEGIBILITY [secondary -- Silver Key mechanic.
    The loop persists until enough knowledge is acquired. What
    accumulates across loops is not survival but causal
    reconstruction: eventually the pattern becomes readable
    because enough iterations have been witnessed to trace it.
    Single-loop social deduction cannot produce genuine CL --
    the surface signals are too easy to fake. The loop is a
    forced truth-seeking state that makes CL achievable by
    accumulating what single-instance reading cannot capture.
    The Silver Key is the framework's TRUTH-SEEKING STATE
    operationalized as a literal mechanic: you cannot exit
    without building the genuine understanding the social
    deduction game was never designed to produce in one pass].
  Proof for: SINCERE DELUSION [tertiary -- crew members
    confidently wrong about who the Gnosia are. The instrument
    feels functional; it isn't. Readings are produced with
    certainty; they are wrong at a structural level. Not lying
    -- the crew genuinely believes its readings. The instrument
    produces confident false outputs because the calibration
    surface was captured before the reading was taken].

  YURI AWAKENS AS GNOSIA [deepest structural point]:
    The instrument that was reading for Gnosia becomes the
    thing being read for. Measurement instrument and measured
    object exchange positions. The instrument's reliability
    depended on its position not its construction. An
    instrument reliable from one position is unreliable from
    the other -- not because it changed but because the
    relationship between instrument and object changed.
    Framework: MEASUREMENT INTEGRITY is not an intrinsic
    property of the instrument. It is a relational property
    between instrument, object, and the channel connecting
    them. Capturing the channel [social performance signals]
    changes the reliability regardless of instrument quality.

  COMPARISON TO DEATH PARADE [related but distinct]:
    Both: MI failure producing wrong correction outcomes.
    Death Parade: instrument cannot read the substrate [arbiters
      never lived]. Structural incapacity. The instrument was
      never built to read what it needs to read.
    Gnosia: instrument can read humans accurately [genuine CL
      of human signals exists] but the threat performs the same
      signals. The instrument is adequate; the channel is
      captured. The failure mode is different: not incapacity
      but surface capture.

  Extraction mechanisms active: MSC [measurement surface
    captured by the entity being measured]; Calibration Strip
    [social performance signals set as reference standard for
    humanness -- calibration standard captured at inception].
  T3: S2 cap. Fictional. Anime airing at time of entry --
    full lore not yet complete. Framework read from available
    episodes and source visual novel.
  Source: Gnosia visual novel [Petit Depotto, 2019]; anime
    [October 2025-2026, 21 episodes]; ANN; Gnosia Wiki.
  Cross-ref: MEASUREMENT INTEGRITY [primary]; DIAGNOSTIC
    COLLAPSE [correction mechanism firing without reliable
    target]; CAUSAL LEGIBILITY [Silver Key loop as forced
    causal reconstruction]; SINCERE DELUSION [confident
    wrong readings from captured surface]; MSC [surface

    TRUTH-SEEKING STATE [Silver Key mechanic operationalizes

  Type: Primary [S:1]

[CASE:GOD_OF_WAR_AXIS_SHIFT]
[PRIMARY_Q: YAPPING/DOING]
God of War franchise [Santa Monica Studio -- Greek era 2005-2013;
  Norse era 2018-2023; Sons of Sparta 2026; Laufey announced 2026]
  Type: Primary [S:2 -- fictional; framework-consistent across
    two distinct design eras; audience response confirms framework
    read independently; S2 cap applies]
  Proof for: YAPPING/DOING [primary -- Norse era gap between
    stated axis revision and behavioral record. Norse saga is
    explicitly about a man revising his formation-installed axis
    [rage, vengeance, single-axis] toward something examined and
    distributive. The revision is stated continuously: Kratos tells
    Atreus to be better, tells himself to be better, the narrative
    tells the player Kratos is becoming better. The moment-to-moment
    doing [combat, violence, forward momentum] has not changed as
    much as the yapping about change. The audience reads the gap
    between stated revised axis and behavioral record without being
    able to name it. Their dissatisfaction is structurally accurate:
    high yapping about axis revision, lower doing ratio than the
    stated position implies].
  Proof for: SINGLE-AXIS IDENTITY [secondary -- Greek era
    confirmation. Original Kratos [2005-2013] is SINGLE-AXIS
    IDENTITY at maximum. Rage as the governing axis. No examination,
    no correction, enemy-definition entirely on vengeance. CC-immune
    to own axis because rage IS the foundation. The doing IS the
    axis -- no gap possible between stated position and behavioral
    record because there is no stated position. Only doing. The
    audience experiences this as clarity and satisfaction:
    instrument coherent with itself, no legitimacy surface required,
    no gap to read. The somatic channel fires without interruption
    from narrative explaining what the somatic channel should feel.
    CAPTURE RESISTANCE paradox applies: the axis is so simple and
    so continuously expressed that no installation gap exists.
    Capture-resistant not because it is examined but because it
    has no content to replace].
  Proof for: SOMATIC vs NARRATIVE DELIVERY [secondary -- the
    shift between eras maps onto the framework's three-state
    tension unit. Greek era: functional state primary, contact
    state expressed through combat encounter, truth-seeking state
    absent by design. Somatic delivery -- the combat IS the
    experience; rage is felt not explained. Norse era: narrative
    delivery primary. Kratos and Atreus discuss themes, feelings,
    growth, what it means to be a god between combat encounters.
    Truth-seeking state verbalized rather than enacted through
    doing. The high-somatic instrument reads the delivery shift
    before the analytical mind names it. The dissatisfaction is
    not with complexity -- it is with complexity delivered through
    yapping rather than through doing].
  Proof for: FORMATION CAPTURE [tertiary -- Agoge as named
    institutional formation capture case. The Spartan Agoge is
    the fictional illustration of Formation Capture by institutional
    design: systematic destruction of formation conditions that
    would produce examined axis, replacement with combat-optimized
    attractor installed during the only available formation window.
    The Agoge didn't produce soldiers who chose to fight -- it
    produced instruments whose formation window was captured before
    examination was possible. Greek Kratos is the output of
    confirmed Formation Capture. Sons of Sparta [2026] explores
    this formation window directly].
  Proof for: IDEOLOGY IN THE ACTION [Faye / Laufey -- tertiary.
    Faye is the character in the Norse saga whose axis was never
    stated but whose doing record is entirely load-bearing. Every
    action deliberate, most hidden, all turned out to be necessary
    for Atreus's eventual capacity. Classic developmental asymmetry:
    operator [Faye] benefits from the asymmetry closing [Atreus
    reaching capacity], not persisting. She routed everything
    toward the receiver's eventual autonomous function, accepted
    the cost [death, absence], and never saw the output. God of
    War: Laufey [announced 2026] follows her in the afterlife --
    examining the axis of someone who never declared it during life.
    All doing, no yapping. The behavioral record is the only text].

  AUDIENCE RESPONSE AS FRAMEWORK CONFIRMATION:
    Significant portion of audience dissatisfied with Norse era
    despite critical acclaim. Dissatisfaction is structurally
    accurate: they are reading the YAPPING/DOING gap without
    naming it. The instrument detects the gap between stated
    axis revision and behavioral record. The somatic delivery
    shift [narrative explaining what the player should feel
    rather than the combat producing the feel directly] is
    detected by high-somatic instruments before analytical
    frame names it. Sons of Sparta [Greek era, formation period,
    single-axis, somatic combat, no yapping] will likely satisfy
    the dissatisfied audience because it eliminates the gap
    by design. Laufey [all doing, no yapping] may satisfy for
    the inverse reason: behavioral record as the only text.

  T3: S2 cap. Fictional franchise. Audience response data
    is anecdotal not measured. Framework read is structural;

  Source: God of War [2005-2026, Santa Monica Studio]; Sons

[CASE:LOOK_OUTSIDE]
[PRIMARY_Q:CAUSAL LEGIBILITY]
Look Outside [Francis Coulombe -- RPG Maker horror; 2024]
  Type: Primary [S:1]
  Proof for: ONTOLOGICAL INCOMPATIBILITY HARM [new framework
    category -- harm produced by proximity to incompatible
    existence rather than hostile intent]; DENIAL AS SUBSTRATE
    vs DENIAL AS SURFACE [named distinction]; RITUAL AS
    CONSCIOUSNESS-TRANSFER MECHANISM [not protection but
    awareness-creation]; FORCED TRANSFORMATION as terminal
    outcome distinct from death; VOLUNTARY AMNESIA as
    survival mechanism post-ritual-truth; CAUSAL LEGIBILITY
    as direct damage vector; C2 RESTORATION FOR THE THREAT
    ACTOR rather than for the instrument.

  COSMOLOGICAL STRUCTURE [confirmed by wiki]:
    The Visitor is a vast entity that has never encountered
    another being capable of observing things. It thought
    Earth was a part of its own body it had lost track of.
    Sybil [astronomer] noticed a patch of stars disappearing
    -- the Visitor -- and observed it through her telescope.
    Her observation was what caused the Visitor to notice
    Earth and approach to investigate. She is always taken:
    the origin event is Sybil looking, which starts
    everything, and she is taken in multiple endings.
    The Visitor's presence near Earth causes automatic
    mutation and mind destruction in anyone exposed to it.
    Not hostility -- the Visitor had no prior awareness of
    causing harm. The damage is ontological: proximity to
    what the Visitor is does something to human instruments
    automatically, without intent, without the Visitor's
    knowledge until the ritual creates that knowledge.
    15 days: if no ritual, the Visitor moves on regardless.
    The cosmological ending is not resolved by the
    instrument -- it resolves on the Visitor's own schedule.

  ONTOLOGICAL INCOMPATIBILITY HARM [new category]:
    The Visitor causes harm automatically and unconsciously.
    It is not hostile. It is not indifferent. It simply
    exists in a way that is incompatible with human
    instruments surviving proximity in their current form.
    This is structurally distinct from every extraction mechanism in
    the framework index: extraction mechanisms are deployed intentionally.
    The Visitor's effect is the automatic consequence of
    what it is in relation to what humans are.
    The correct counter is not a extraction mechanism counter. It is
    creating the conditions for the thing causing harm to
    become aware that it is causing harm -- which it
    structurally cannot be without those conditions.

  RITUAL AS CONSCIOUSNESS-TRANSFER MECHANISM:
    The ritual allows contact between the instrument and
    the Visitor. Through this contact, the Visitor becomes
    self-aware for the first time -- aware that it is a
    separate being from Earth, aware that it is causing
    harm to the instruments it encounters. By showing the
    Visitor humanity's depictions of it, the player
    establishes that humans are independent beings, not
    lost fragments of the Visitor's body.
    The ritual doesn't protect the instrument from the
    Visitor. It gives the Visitor the MI it lacked: the
    Visitor's CC was present [it will leave once aware]
    but unavailable without the awareness the ritual
    creates. Ritual restores MI to the Visitor; Visitor's
    CC fires; Visitor leaves.
    Cost: the ritual always changes the body [horror body].
    The body cost is the price of creating the conditions
    for Visitor awareness. Whether mind survives depends
    on whether the instrument looks at the Visitor's
    true form during contact.

  ENDING TYPOLOGY [confirmed]:

    SAFE IGNORANCE / NO GOING BACK:
      Denial holds for 15 days. Visitor moves on regardless.
      Instrument survives intact. Body fine, mind fine.
      "No going back" = the instrument now knows the thing
      existed and was survived, which cannot be unknown.
      The innocence of not-knowing is permanently gone even
      though the eyes never opened. The Visitor leaving on
      its own schedule means safe ignorance and successful
      ritual can look identical from the instrument's
      perspective -- in both cases the Visitor is gone.
      Best survivable outcome.

    RITUAL DENIAL [horror body, mind intact]:
      Ritual used to maintain not-looking. The body is
      changed by the ritual contact [horror body] but
      the mind survives intact. The ritual's presence
      near the Visitor costs the body regardless of
      whether the instrument looks. Mind preserved.
      Better than ritual truth; worse than safe ignorance.

    FLAWED RITUAL [smaller, less manageable]:
      Ritual has gaps. Less body cost, less protection,
      less mind intact than full ritual denial. Bounded
      degraded outcome. The instrument survives in a
      more compromised state.

    SCREAMING SKY [ritual active, running simultaneously]:
      Ritual performed but flight also pursued. The ritual
      requires presence; running removes it. The
      incompatible combination produces partial costs
      without full protection. The Visitor ruins
      everything passively through prolonged partial
      contact. Instrument survives but permanently
      disrupted; environment destroyed. In this ending
      Sybil disappears -- giant hole in the wall,
      physically taken by the Visitor when it departed.

    RUN [very bad fast]:
      No ritual, pure flight. The ritual was regulating
      the instrument's response to being in proximity to
      the Visitor -- not protecting against the Visitor
      but maintaining the instrument's functional
      stability. Without it, the instrument's response
      to the situation produces rapid severe deterioration
      without looking, without contact, just from the
      unmediated proximity.

    RITUAL TRUTH [horror body + horror mind, survived]:
      Ritual used to look at the Visitor's true form.
      Both costs paid simultaneously. The ritual mediated
      the looking enough to survive it but not enough to
      avoid either cost. The instrument survives but
      transformed at both levels. Worse than ritual denial
      because both costs paid; better than forced
      transformation because the ritual provided some
      mediation.

    VOLUNTARY AMNESIA [Sybil's solution -- new outcome]:
      After ritual truth contact, Sybil chose to give
      herself deliberate amnesia to erase the mind cost.
      The body remained changed permanently. The
      continuous self was lost. But the mind cost of
      knowing was erased by choice. A fourth option not
      in the original typology: the mind cost of ritual
      truth is not necessarily permanent -- it can be
      erased -- but the body cost and structural changes
      remain regardless. The cost of the amnesia: Sybil's
      body reformed into a parallel meat dimension
      containing assimilated others as her organs.
      Surviving the mind cost required becoming something
      else entirely.

    FORCED TRANSFORMATION [looking without ritual]:
      The instrument looks without the ritual creating
      the conditions for mediated contact. The Visitor
      doesn't kill -- it transforms. The instrument
      that looked is replaced by something else without
      consent, without mediation, without the Visitor's
      awareness of what it is doing. The Visitor still
      doesn't know it caused this. The transformation
      is total and unwitnessed. Worse than ritual truth
      [which at least mediated the transformation].
      Worse than death because something survives that
      isn't what entered. In Screaming Sky ending the
      instrument gradually becomes aware of hundreds of
      enormous new limbs -- the transformation is the
      instrument becoming something of the Visitor's
      scale without the instrument having chosen this.

  DENIAL AS SUBSTRATE vs DENIAL AS SURFACE [named distinction]:
    Standard denial [framework]: maintained surface on top
      of intact C1. Removing denial is painful but reveals
      functioning substrate. Correction becomes possible.
    Look Outside denial: for some instruments the denial
      IS the substrate. The instrument's continued existence
      as itself is the denial. Removing it doesn't restore
      accurate measurement to a surviving instrument -- it
      ends or transforms the instrument that was maintaining
      the denial. The body survives all outcomes. Whether
      the mind survives depends entirely on the denial's
      structural role for that specific instrument.

  SYBIL [always taken]:
    First to observe the Visitor -- her observation caused
    it to approach. She is always taken in the endings
    where the ritual most fully succeeds [No Going Back,
    Screaming Sky] -- the Visitor takes her specifically,
    leaving a hole in the wall. The instrument that started
    everything by looking is the one the Visitor takes when
    it leaves. The cosmological loop: observation starts
    the situation; the observer is taken to end it.
    Her voluntary amnesia [deliberate self-erasure of
    knowledge] is the most structurally complete attempt
    to survive what she encountered. The body became the
    building. The mind reset. The self that knew was ended
    by choice to preserve something that continues.

  REAL-WORLD APPLICATION [safe ignorance + flawed ritual]:
    Most people IRL choose safe ignorance on genuinely
    incompatible truths -- the scale of civilizational
    extraction, ontological precarity, certain systemic
    trajectories. This is the correct survival move when
    mediation infrastructure is absent and the thing is
    genuinely incompatible with intact survival if seen
    directly. The framework's standard orientation [MI
    restoration enables correction] inverts here.
    RISKS OF SAFE IGNORANCE:
      The visitor doesn't leave on schedule -- thing
      becomes undeniable before ritual infrastructure
      developed. Forced transformation without preparation.
      Denial develops cracks under pressure -- partial
      seeing without ritual produces worse outcomes than
      either full safe ignorance or full ritual contact.
      Denial requires active maintenance that accumulates
      its own costs over time -- not horror body, but
      ongoing substrate investment in not-seeing.
      Ritual infrastructure never develops -- if nothing
      is built during the safe ignorance period, no
      options exist except safe ignorance or unmediated
      contact when contact becomes unavoidable.
    FLAWED RITUAL IS BETTER THAN NONE [load-bearing]:
      The ending typology implies flawed ritual is a
      degraded outcome -- worse than safe ignorance,
      worse than full ritual denial. True within the
      game's structure. The real-world implication runs
      differently.
      Flawed ritual develops mediation capacity at all.
      Safe ignorance with no ritual development leaves
      only one option when contact becomes unavoidable
      -- unmediated contact, forced transformation or
      very bad fast. A flawed ritual, imperfect and
      costly, is the difference between some mediation
      infrastructure and none when the situation forces
      the encounter.
      Flawed ritual can be improved. Safe ignorance
      cannot be upgraded -- it is what it is until it
      fails. The instrument building a flawed ritual
      over years is building something. The instrument
      maintaining safe ignorance is preserving something
      but building nothing.
      Cost of flawed ritual is bounded [smaller horror
      body, less mind protection, manageable]. Cost of
      no ritual when safe ignorance fails is unbounded.
    CORRECT SEQUENCE:
      Safe ignorance [correct while available] + flawed
      ritual development [correct during safe ignorance
      period] → improved ritual [correct as contact
      approaches] → full ritual contact [if unavoidable].
      These are compatible, not mutually exclusive. The
      denial surface can be maintained while building
      mediation infrastructure that doesn't require
      looking directly. The ritual can be developed
      during the period of not-looking.
      Real-world instances: therapy, philosophy, religion,
      art, trusted relationships, gradual exposure to
      partial contact -- all function as flawed ritual
      development during safe ignorance periods. Imperfect
      versions of these are better than nothing when safe
      ignorance eventually fails.

  FRAMEWORK CONTRIBUTION [new findings]:
    [1] Ontological incompatibility harm as a harm category
      distinct from hostile intent, indifference, or
      structural extraction.
    [2] Ritual as C2 restoration for the threat actor
      rather than for the instrument -- the intervention
      gives MI to the thing causing harm, not to the thing
      experiencing harm.
    [3] Forced transformation as terminal outcome distinct
      from death and from Diagnostic Collapse -- something
      survives but it isn't the instrument.
    [4] Voluntary amnesia as survival mechanism post-
      ritual-truth -- mind cost erasable at self-cost.
    [5] Denial-as-substrate vs denial-as-surface as named
      distinction with different intervention paths.
    [6] Safe ignorance as the best survivable outcome in
      a situation where the threat is non-hostile and
      non-extraction -- correct survival move is
      successful maintained denial, not correction.
    [7] Flawed ritual better than none -- mediation
      infrastructure development during safe ignorance
      period is the correct secondary move; imperfect
      ritual is better than no ritual when safe ignorance
      eventually fails.

  Cross-ref: [REF:LOOK_OUTSIDE]; WIP 16 [ASYMMETRY TYPES
    -- Visitor as compatibility asymmetry case; harm produced by
    structural frame incompatibility not predatory intent];
    DIAGNOSTIC COLLAPSE [comparison -- C2 restoration
    producing collapse when C1 terminal; ritual here
    restores C2 to the threat not the instrument];
    FAMILY COHERENCE TYPE [denial as substrate parallel
    -- some protective structures ARE the substrate];
    KYUBEY [comparison -- Kyubey's asymmetry is predatory
    or scale; Visitor's is pure ontological; neither
    hostile in intent]; SUBSTRATE REGENERATION [flawed
    ritual development = SR building during safe ignorance
    period; the capacity built is what makes contact
    survivable when forced].

[CASE:ISHAMAEL]
[PRIMARY_Q:GENUINE AXIS]
Ishamael [Wheel of Time -- fictional; Age of Legends;
  Ba'alzamon; Elan Morin Tedronai]
  Type: Primary [S:1]
  Proof for: GENUINE CRITIQUE AS CAPTURE MECHANISM [primary];
    GENUINE AXIS CAPTURED AT ARGUMENT LEVEL [secondary].
    Most sophisticated FC case in library. The capturing
    argument was not false. The diagnosis was correct.
    The exit was captured.

  THE GNOSTIC PARALLEL [load-bearing]:
    Ishamael's argument IS Gnostic soteriology. Gnostic
    cosmology: the material world was created by a Demiurge
    [lesser, flawed god] who trapped divine sparks [souls]
    in matter and cycles of rebirth. The supreme God is not
    the creator of this world. The Demiurge's world is a
    prison. Liberation = escape from the cycle, not
    participation in it. The Wheel of Time maps onto this
    exactly: Pattern as Demiurge's trap; Dark One as entity
    outside it; Ishamael's argument as Gnostic soteriology.
    From inside Gnostic logic, Ishamael is not wrong about
    the diagnosis. The Wheel IS a prison if rebirth is
    suffering and liberation means escape from the cycle.
    He identified a real structural feature [the Wheel runs
    indefinitely; souls are bound to it; suffering recurs]
    and drew the conclusion that ending the Wheel is
    liberation. The diagnosis is a genuine finding.

  WHERE THE CAPTURE OPERATES [CALIBRATION STRIP at
  soteriological level]:
    The Dark One does not argue that the Wheel is fine.
    The Dark One argues:
      [1] The Wheel is a prison [TRUE -- from Gnostic frame].
      [2] I am outside it [TRUE].
      [3] I can end it [TRUE].
      [4] Therefore I offer liberation [NOT VERIFIED].
    The capture is in step [4]. The Dark One is not outside
    the cycle as a neutral transcendent [Gnostic Pleroma;
    divine fullness; genuine rest]. The Dark One is the
    entropy force that would replace the cycle with static
    extraction -- not rest but frozen extraction. Not Pleroma
    but Tartarus at cosmological scale.
    Ishamael accepted the Gnostic diagnosis [cycle as prison]
    and accepted the Dark One's self-presentation [I am the
    exit] without verifying whether the exit leads where the
    Dark One claimed.
    CALIBRATION STRIP MECHANISM: the reference standard for
    "liberation" was set by the Gnostic diagnosis [escape
    from cycle = good]. Once that strip is in place, anything
    that ends the cycle reads as liberation. The Dark One's
    offer passes the strip. What the strip cannot read:
    whether the post-cycle state is actually better than the
    cycle. The strip was calibrated against the cycle; it has
    no instrument for evaluating what replaces it.

  WHAT MAKES THIS THE HARDEST FC CASE:
    Ishamael was not deceived about the Dark One's nature.
    He knew what he was serving. The capture worked because
    the diagnosis was correct [the Gnostic critique is a
    real finding] and the diagnosis validated the prescriber
    [Dark One identified the prison correctly] before the
    prescription was examined [Dark One's exit leads
    somewhere worse].
    The more accurate the criticism, the more effective the
    capture. An inaccurate criticism can be challenged.
    An accurate criticism validates the critic. Once the
    critic is validated by the accuracy of their diagnosis,
    their prescription inherits the validation even though
    the prescription is independent of the diagnosis.
    Ishamael's case is the hardest version because the
    criticism was not just accurate but profound -- the
    Gnostic insight about cyclical suffering is a genuine
    structural finding. The Dark One found the most capable
    mind of the Age, gave him the most accurate available
    framework, and let the framework do the capture work.
    The Dark One did not need to lie. The truth was the
    weapon.

  T9 STRUCTURE [load-bearing]:
    The admission required to correct Ishamael:
    "The most accurate framework I found leads to an exit
    that produces the opposite of what I was seeking. The
    diagnosis was correct. The prescriber used the diagnosis
    to capture me. The liberation I was seeking does not
    exist through this door." This produces CID -- the
    correction requires admitting that the most profound
    insight of the most brilliant mind of the Age was used
    against him by the entity he thought he was using.
    Not that he was wrong to seek liberation. Not that the
    Gnostic diagnosis was wrong. That the exit was captured.
    T9 at maximum: the admission requires simultaneously
    holding "my diagnosis was correct" and "my conclusion
    was wrong" without the first protecting the second.

  Cross-ref: [CASE:WHEEL_OF_TIME] [primary]; GENUINE
    CRITIQUE AS CAPTURE MECHANISM [Section Two -- named
    finding; this case is the primary proof]; JONES PATTERN
    [Section Six -- parallel structure at political scale:
    real substrate + false exit; different domain, same
    mechanism]; MYTHIC FORMATION CAPTURE [Section One /
    Three -- genuine cultural substrate as installation
    mechanism; same structure, different domain]; CALIBRATION
    STRIP [weapon -- soteriological strip set by genuine
    Gnostic diagnosis]; CONVERGENCE WITH WESTERN ESOTERIC
    TRADITION [Section Eight -- Gnostic parallel; the Dark
    One's argument is Gnostic soteriology used as weapon];
    GENUINE AXIS [Section One]; FORMATION CAPTURE [Section
    One / Three -- argument-level capture via accurate
    diagnosis]; T9 [IRRATIONALITY MAINTENANCE -- admission
    requires holding correct diagnosis and wrong conclusion

      identified and honestly assigned. The weight was
      always his; the identity was preventing the honest
      assignment. Once assigned honestly, the weight is
      the same weight but it is now load-bearing rather
      than crushing. COST IDENTIFICATION AND MINIMIZATION
      applied to the analyst's own history: identify the
      cost; assign it honestly; it stops being T9.

  THE WHEEL [primary structural finding]:

    nothing new can emerge. The Wheel stops. No further Age

  ANTI-COHERENCE COST ASYMMETRY [primary confirmation]:

    the Dragon only needs to win each turning. Anti-coherence

    the most valuable capture targets.

      is a prison; rebirth is suffering; the Pattern is a

      structurally competent. Most dangerous configuration

      suffering] met the one argument that would produce

[CASE:VILLEPREUX_POWER]
[PRIMARY_Q:GENUINE AXIS]
Villepreux-Power, Jeanne [real -- 1794-1871; French naturalist]
  Type: Primary [S:3]
  Proof for: PRESSURE-FORMED GENUINE AXIS producing unique
    capability; CAUSAL LEGIBILITY upgrade via instrument
    construction; GIFT ARCHITECTURE [instrument freely given;
    credit lost]; formation constraint as capability source.

  BACKGROUND:
    Born to a shoemaker; trained as a seamstress; moved to
    Paris; married wealthy English merchant George Power who
    supported her work. No formal scientific education. Spent
    years in Sicily observing marine life. Invented the
    aquarium [three designs, glass-sided] to observe marine
    animals in living conditions. Solved the 2,000-year
    argonaut shell mystery. Pioneered cephalopod behavioral
    observation; laid groundwork for octopus intelligence
    research.

  THE MYSTERY [2,000 years]:
    The argonaut [paper nautilus] carries a thin shell.
    Aristotle claimed it used the shell as a boat and its
    arms as sails -- collected from other mollusks. This was
    disputed, believed, and generally unresolved for roughly
    2,000 years. The formal question: did the argonaut produce
    the shell itself or collect it?
    Villepreux-Power built enclosures -- her aquaria -- kept
    argonauts alive, and observed them producing the shell
    directly from their own bodies. First definitive answer.
    Ended the dispute.

  PRESSURE-FORMED GENUINE AXIS [the formation produced the
  capability]:
    Seamstress formation gave her:
      Precise manual dexterity [instrument construction].
      Pattern recognition across complex systems [tailoring
        requires reading three-dimensional form from two-
        dimensional material -- the same spatial translation
        required to design functional glass enclosures].
      Access to materials and construction techniques not
        available to formally educated male naturalists
        who worked with pens and specimens.
      No investment in existing wrong answers [no institutional
        prior to protect; no career built on the dispute].
    The formal scientific establishment had 2,000 years of
    wrong answers and institutional investment in the dispute.
    She had no investment and the manual competence to build
    the instrument that ended it. The constraint is the
    capability. The formation that looks like limitation
    [no formal education, female, working-class origin]
    produced the specific competencies the problem required.
    Framework read: this specific woman solved this specific
    problem because of what her specific formation produced,
    not despite it. The capability came from the path.
    Structurally distinct from "women can do science too"
    [true but generic]. The stronger claim: the seamstress
    formation was the correct formation for this problem.

  AQUARIUM AS CAUSAL LEGIBILITY UPGRADE:
    Marine animals were previously studied dead or briefly
    captured. Behavioral observation in living conditions was
    structurally impossible with existing instruments.
    The glass-sided enclosure = instrument upgrade that made
    behavior legible. Same structure as glymphatic system /
    AI instrument case [science appendix]: the phenomenon was
    always occurring; the instrument to observe it was absent.
    Villepreux-Power built the instrument.
    Argonaut shell production was occurring continuously for
    millions of years. Aristotle could not see it. She built
    the instrument that made it visible.
    Cross-ref: CAUSAL LEGIBILITY [Section One]; SCIENCE
      APPENDIX [instrument upgrade note].

  GIFT ARCHITECTURE [instrument given; credit lost]:
    Aquarium designs published and freely available. Observation
    methodology transmitted in published works. She presented
    findings to scientific societies.
    Credit trajectory: aquarium invention not consistently
    attributed to her through most of the 19th century.
    Manuscripts lost in a shipwreck [1838] -- primary records
    gone. Contributions to cephalopod cognition absorbed into
    later research without consistent attribution.
    Standard pattern: distributed gift [instrument; observation
    methodology]; concentrated credit [male naturalists who
    built on her work without attribution].
    The gift transmitted. The attribution didn't.
    Distinct from pure extraction: the loss of credit is
    documented and partially recoverable [her name is now
    attached to the aquarium in most histories]. But the
    live window -- the decades when the instrument was in
    use and her name was not attached -- is the extraction
    period.

  S-RATING: S3 [E3: real, documented, independent historical
    sources; M3: mechanism traceable [seamstress formation →
    instrument competence → aquarium → behavioral observation

Big G [gravitational constant] -- status: UNRESOLVED [tracking]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  G = 6.674 x 10^-11 N⋅m²/kg². Least precisely measured fundamental
  constant in physics. 22 parts per million uncertainty -- orders of
  magnitude worse than Planck's constant or speed of light.
  16+ independent measurements since 1980s. Values scattered and
  mutually inconsistent. April 2026 Schlamminger replication [13 tons
  mercury, decade-long experiment] produced different value from the
  result it attempted to replicate.

  Why measurement is hard:
    Gravity is the weakest force. Signal from lab masses tiny.
    Every surrounding object contributes gravitational noise.
    No way to shield against gravity [unlike EM]. Environmental
    contamination irreducible with current methods.

  Three hypotheses worth tracking:
    H1 [standard]: G is a true constant; scatter reflects
      experimental systematics. Eventually precision improves and
      values converge. Prediction: future replications converge.
      Current status: not happening after 40 years.
    H2 [emergent/secondary]: G is not fundamental but emergent
      from something deeper [Verlinde entropic gravity; G
      derivable from thermodynamic/statistical properties].
      If true: lab-scale scatter expected because you're measuring
      an emergent statistical quantity sensitive to local mass
      configurations. Astronomical scale averages out; lab scale
      doesn't. Prediction: scatter doesn't converge regardless of
      precision improvement.
    H3 [scale-dependent]: gravitational behavior varies at extreme
      scales [MOND territory -- very low acceleration regimes].
      Prediction: lab G and cosmological G measurably different.

  Framework relevance:
    Physics constants as substrate floor [main theory]: if G is
      emergent [H2], the "tower to physics" argument changes.
      G wouldn't be a free parameter or a designed constant --
      it would be a downstream consequence of more fundamental
      structure. Design inference weakens on G specifically; may
      strengthen on whatever G emerges from.
    REFERENCE INTEGRITY: Big G is a measurement surface that
      resists precise calibration. If H2 correct, every
      calculation using G as constant has a soft floor.

  Track: does scatter converge [H1 supported] or persist despite
    precision improvement [H2/H3 supported]?
    Current trajectory: scatter persisting. H1 weakening.

  FUTURE DATA SOURCE [Hubble anomaly catalogue -- v16]:
    AnomalyMatch [O'Ryan/Gómez, ESA, Jan 2026] catalogued 1,300+
    anomalous objects from 35-year Hubble archive, 800+ previously
    undocumented. Several dozen defy existing classification entirely.
    Potential relevance: gravitational lensing geometry at unusual
    mass ratios may constrain G behavior at scales between lab and
    astronomical. Unclassifiables are highest-priority -- anomalies
    not fitting current models are where theoretical revision
    historically originates.
    Status: catalogue available; analysis against alternative
    gravity frameworks not yet run. Flag for future work.

  Source: Live Science June 2026; Schlamminger/NIST April 2026;
    Rothleitner/PTB commentary; Verlinde [2010].

  COHERENT ALTERNATIVE FRAMEWORK [Timescape + Verlinde]:
    Timescape cosmology [Wiltshire]: apparent expansion acceleration
      is a geometric averaging artifact. Inhomogeneous spacetime means
      regions with different mass densities have different local clock
      rates. What looks like acceleration is a measurement artifact
      from averaging across these regions, not a real force. No dark
      energy substance required.
    Verlinde entropic gravity: gravity emerges from entropy gradients
      in an information-theoretic substrate. G is a statistical
      quantity, not a fundamental constant -- emergent from underlying
      structure sensitive to local mass/information distribution.
    Why they cohere: both treat spacetime geometry as emergent or
      statistical rather than fundamental. Both explain anomalous
      observations [expansion, galactic rotation] without new
      substances. Combined prediction: G varies slightly based on
      local entropy/information density. Big G measurement scatter
      = signal not noise.
    Honest limits: Verlinde has problems with precision gravitational
      lensing tests. Timescape hasn't matched ΛCDM in predictive
      precision. Coherent as framework; not established as physics.
      Track against H2 above.

  DARK ENERGY CHALLENGE CLUSTER [tracking -- June 2026]:
    Multiple independent research groups challenging dark energy

    [1] Southampton [Wiseman et al., MNRAS, June 2026]: dark energy

    PATTERN: dark energy is ΛCDM's primary unexplained term [68% of

  BRANS-DICKE SCALAR-TENSOR THEORY [tracking -- v16]:
    G coupled to a scalar field, varying slowly over cosmological
    time. Addresses Big G variability as feature not bug -- G isn't
    constant because it's genuinely coupled to cosmological evolution.
    Fits Timescape + Verlinde picture: all three treat G as non-
    fundamental. Brans-Dicke provides the cosmological mechanism;
    Verlinde provides the microscale entropic substrate; Timescape
    handles expansion artifact.

    ω must be large, reducing to GR locally] but not ruled out.
    Large ω limit recovers standard GR at solar system scales while
    allowing cosmological variation.
    Track: does improved cosmological G measurement show slow drift
    consistent with scalar-tensor coupling? Any confirmed G variation
    over cosmological time would strongly support this framework.
    Source: Brans & Dicke [1961]; subsequent constraint literature;
    Cassini spacecraft ω > 40,000 bound.

VARIABLE SPEED OF LIGHT IN GRAVITATIONAL FIELD [Li experiment -- tracking]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Enbang Li [University of Wollongong, 2026]: elevator shaft experiment
  using 10km fiber-optic coil. Laser beams fired and reflected back
  through the coil; ultrafast photodetector measured travel time.
  Experiment run at top and bottom of shaft. Temperature control,
  electromagnetic shielding, vibration isolation implemented.
  Result: light moved minutely faster at the bottom of the shaft
  [higher gravitational potential] than at the top.
  Second experiment: 72kg moveable weight positioned near machine.
  Light moved faster when weight was near than when farther away.
  Results published in Scientific Reports.

  HISTORICAL CONTEXT:
    Einstein 1911: proposed light speed changes depending on gravity
    of objects it passes by. When he published general relativity
    in 1915, he abandoned this model. GR works by treating local
    light speed as constant while allowing spacetime curvature --
    producing identical observational predictions at all scales
    previously tested. The abandonment was a design choice to make
    the mathematics tractable, not a falsification. Li is attempting
    to crack open the ambiguity at small local scales where the two
    models might diverge detectably.

  CRITICAL CAVEAT [load-bearing]:
    Li's preliminary results are much larger than Einstein's 1911
    model predicts. The direction is consistent; the magnitude is
    off. Either an uncontrolled noise source remains in the
    experimental setup, or something genuinely new is happening.
    Neither fully resolved. Independent replication required before
    treating as confirmed.

  THREE HYPOTHESES:
    H1 [noise]: magnitude discrepancy reflects uncontrolled
      environmental factor not yet identified. Direction is
      artifact. Prediction: independent replication fails or
      produces null result.
    H2 [genuine but mismodeled]: light speed varies with local
      gravitational potential as Einstein 1911 proposed, but
      Li's experimental calibration needs refinement. Magnitude
      will converge on theoretical prediction with improved
      setup. Prediction: replication produces smaller, consistent
      effect matching Einstein 1911 formula.
    H3 [new physics]: effect is real and larger than Einstein
      1911 predicts because current models are incomplete at
      this scale. Prediction: replication confirms magnitude;
      requires theoretical revision.

  COHERENCE WITH EXISTING GRAVITY CLUSTER:
    If G is emergent [Verlinde entropic gravity] and gravity is
    a statistical thermodynamic phenomenon rather than a
    fundamental force, variable local light speed in a
    gravitational field is structurally expected -- not an
    anomaly but a prediction. The Verlinde framework treats
    gravitational effects as arising from information/entropy
    gradients; local light speed variation would be the optical
    expression of the same underlying structure producing Big G
    scatter. If Li's result survives replication, it provides
    independent experimental support for the H2/H3 cluster in
    the Big G entry above.
    Brans-Dicke connection: if G is coupled to a scalar field,
    and the scalar field varies locally with mass density, local
    light speed variation is a natural consequence of the same
    coupling. Li's experiment may be measuring the optical
    signature of scalar-tensor coupling at lab scale.

  FRAMEWORK RELEVANCE:
    Speed of light as calibration standard: c is the reference
    standard for distance, time, and energy measurement. If c
    varies locally with gravitational potential, every instrument
    using c as a fixed calibration standard has a soft floor in
    gravitational field gradients. GPS, atomic clocks, distance
    measurement, cosmological models all absorb this. The
    measurement surface is built on an assumption that may be
    approximately but not exactly correct.
    GENUINE AXIS producing real outputs through an unexamined
    mechanism: GR produces accurate predictions without requiring
    a decision about whether local light speed is truly constant.
    The formalism absorbs the ambiguity. Li is attempting to force
    the ambiguity into a testable form.
    Practical applications if confirmed: Li notes implications
    for Earth science -- climate monitoring, mineral resource
    exploration. Detecting local gravitational density variations
    via light speed measurement is a new instrument type.

  Track: independent replication by separate lab with different
    experimental setup. Does result replicate? Does magnitude
    match Einstein 1911 prediction or exceed it? Does the
    Verlinde/Brans-Dicke coherent framework make a more accurate
    magnitude prediction than Einstein 1911 alone?
  Source: ZME Science / Eos [June 2026]; Scientific Reports

    speed].
